@login_required
@require_permission('hr.view_employees')
def employee_list(request):
    employees = Employee.objects.all()

    search = request.GET.get('q', '').strip()
    if search:
        employees = employees.filter(
            Q(first_name__icontains=search) |
            Q(last_name__icontains=search) |
            Q(mobile__icontains=search) |
            Q(national_id__icontains=search)
        )

    position = request.GET.get('position', '')
    if position:
        employees = employees.filter(position=position)

    status = request.GET.get('status', '')
    if status == 'active':
        employees = employees.filter(is_active=True)
    elif status == 'inactive':
        employees = employees.filter(is_active=False)

    stats = {
        'total': Employee.objects.count(),
        'active': Employee.objects.filter(is_active=True).count(),
        'inactive': Employee.objects.filter(is_active=False).count(),
    }

    paginator = Paginator(employees, 20)
    page_obj = paginator.get_page(request.GET.get('page', 1))

    context = {
        'page_obj': page_obj,
        'stats': stats,
        'search': search,
        'current_position': position,
        'current_status': status,
        'position_choices': Employee.POSITION_CHOICES,
    }
    return render(request, 'hr/employee_list.html', context)


@login_required
@require_permission('hr.view_employees')
def employee_detail(request, pk):
    employee = get_object_or_404(Employee, pk=pk)

    open_tasks = employee.tasks.filter(
        status__in=['pending', 'in_progress']
    ).order_by('due_date')[:10]

    done_tasks_count = employee.tasks.filter(status='done').count()
    open_tasks_count = employee.tasks.filter(
        status__in=['pending', 'in_progress']
    ).count()

    context = {
        'employee': employee,
        'open_tasks': open_tasks,
        'done_tasks_count': done_tasks_count,
        'open_tasks_count': open_tasks_count,
    }
    return render(request, 'hr/employee_detail.html', context)


@login_required
@require_permission('hr.manage_employees')
def employee_create(request):
    if request.method == 'POST':
        form = EmployeeForm(request.POST)
        if form.is_valid():
            employee = form.save()
            show_duplicate_warnings(request, form)
            messages.success(request, f'کارمند «{employee.full_name}» اضافه شد.')
            return redirect('hr:employee_detail', pk=employee.pk)
    else:
        form = EmployeeForm()

    return render(request, 'hr/employee_form.html', {
        'form': form,
        'title': 'افزودن کارمند جدید',
        'submit_label': 'ذخیره',
    })


@login_required
@require_permission('hr.manage_employees')
def employee_edit(request, pk):
    employee = get_object_or_404(Employee, pk=pk)
    if request.method == 'POST':
        form = EmployeeForm(request.POST, instance=employee)
        if form.is_valid():
            form.save()
            show_duplicate_warnings(request, form)
            messages.success(request, 'اطلاعات کارمند به‌روزرسانی شد.')
            return redirect('hr:employee_detail', pk=employee.pk)
    else:
        form = EmployeeForm(instance=employee)

    return render(request, 'hr/employee_form.html', {
        'form': form,
        'title': f'ویرایش {employee.full_name}',
        'submit_label': 'ذخیره تغییرات',
        'employee': employee,
    })


@login_required
@require_permission('hr.manage_employees')
def employee_delete(request, pk):
    employee = get_object_or_404(Employee, pk=pk)
    if request.method == 'POST':
        name = employee.full_name
        employee.delete()
        messages.success(request, f'کارمند «{name}» حذف شد.')
        return redirect('hr:employee_list')

@login_required
@require_permission('hr.view_tasks')
def task_list(request):
    tasks = Task.objects.select_related('assigned_to', 'created_by').all()

    search = request.GET.get('q', '').strip()
    if search:
        tasks = tasks.filter(
            Q(title__icontains=search) |
            Q(description__icontains=search)
        )

    status = request.GET.get('status', '')
    if status:
        tasks = tasks.filter(status=status)

    priority = request.GET.get('priority', '')
    if priority:
        tasks = tasks.filter(priority=priority)

    employee = request.GET.get('employee', '')
    if employee:
        tasks = tasks.filter(assigned_to_id=employee)

    today = timezone.now().date()
    stats = {
        'total': Task.objects.count(),
        'pending': Task.objects.filter(status='pending').count(),
        'in_progress': Task.objects.filter(status='in_progress').count(),
        'overdue': Task.objects.filter(
            due_date__lt=today
        ).exclude(status__in=['done', 'cancelled']).count(),
    }

    paginator = Paginator(tasks, 20)
    page_obj = paginator.get_page(request.GET.get('page', 1))

    employees = Employee.objects.filter(is_active=True)

    context = {
        'page_obj': page_obj,
        'stats': stats,
        'search': search,
        'current_status': status,
        'current_priority': priority,
        'current_employee': employee,
        'employees': employees,
        'status_choices': Task.STATUS_CHOICES,
        'priority_choices': Task.PRIORITY_CHOICES,
    }
    return render(request, 'hr/task_list.html', context)

    task = get_object_or_404(Task, pk=pk)
    if request.method == 'POST':
        new_status = request.POST.get('status')
        if new_status in dict(Task.STATUS_CHOICES):
            task.status = new_status
            task.save()
            messages.success(request, f'وضعیت وظیفه به «{task.get_status_display()}» تغییر کرد.')
    return redirect('hr:task_detail', pk=task.pk)

@login_required
def leave_list(request):
    leaves = LeaveRequest.objects.select_related('employee', 'reviewed_by').all()

    status = request.GET.get('status', '')
    if status:
        leaves = leaves.filter(status=status)

    leave_type = request.GET.get('leave_type', '')
    if leave_type:
        leaves = leaves.filter(leave_type=leave_type)

    search = request.GET.get('q', '').strip()
    if search:
        leaves = leaves.filter(
            Q(employee__first_name__icontains=search) |
            Q(employee__last_name__icontains=search) |
            Q(reason__icontains=search)
        )

    stats = {
        'total': LeaveRequest.objects.count(),
        'pending': LeaveRequest.objects.filter(status='pending').count(),
        'approved': LeaveRequest.objects.filter(status='approved').count(),
        'rejected': LeaveRequest.objects.filter(status='rejected').count(),
    }

    paginator = Paginator(leaves, 20)
    page_obj = paginator.get_page(request.GET.get('page', 1))

    context = {
        'page_obj': page_obj,
        'stats': stats,
        'search': search,
        'current_status': status,
        'current_type': leave_type,
        'status_choices': LeaveRequest.STATUS_CHOICES,
        'type_choices': LeaveRequest.LEAVE_TYPE_CHOICES,
    }
    return render(request, 'hr/leave_list.html', context)

        form = LeaveRequestForm(request.POST)
        if form.is_valid():
            leave = form.save()
            messages.success(request, 'درخواست مرخصی ثبت شد.')
            return redirect('hr:leave_list')
    else:
        form = LeaveRequestForm()

    return render(request, 'hr/leave_form.html', {
        'form': form,
        'title': 'ثبت درخواست مرخصی',
        'submit_label': 'ثبت درخواست',
    })


@login_required
@require_permission('hr.review_leaves')
def leave_review(request, pk):
    leave = get_object_or_404(LeaveRequest, pk=pk)

    if request.method == 'POST':
        action = request.POST.get('action')
        note = request.POST.get('review_note', '').strip()

        if action == 'approve':
            leave.status = 'approved'
        elif action == 'reject':
            leave.status = 'rejected'

        leave.reviewed_by = request.user
        leave.reviewed_at = timezone.now()
        leave.review_note = note
        leave.save()

        messages.success(request, f'درخواست {leave.get_status_display()}.')
        return redirect('hr:leave_list')

    return render(request, 'hr/leave_review.html', {'leave': leave})

@login_required
@require_permission('hr.attendance')
def attendance_list(request):
    attendances = Attendance.objects.select_related('employee').all()

    from_date = request.GET.get('from', '')
    to_date = request.GET.get('to', '')

    if from_date:
        try:
            j = jdatetime.date(*map(int, from_date.split('/')))
            g = j.togregorian()
            attendances = attendances.filter(date__gte=g)
        except (ValueError, AttributeError):
            pass
    else:
        attendances = attendances.filter(date=timezone.now().date())

    if to_date:
        try:
            j = jdatetime.date(*map(int, to_date.split('/')))
            g = j.togregorian()
            attendances = attendances.filter(date__lte=g)
        except (ValueError, AttributeError):
            pass

    employee = request.GET.get('employee', '')
    if employee:
        attendances = attendances.filter(employee_id=employee)

    status = request.GET.get('status', '')
    if status:
        attendances = attendances.filter(status=status)

    stats = {
        'today': Attendance.objects.filter(date=timezone.now().date()).count(),
        'present_today': Attendance.objects.filter(
            date=timezone.now().date(), status='present'
        ).count(),
        'late_today': Attendance.objects.filter(
            date=timezone.now().date(), status='late'
        ).count(),
        'absent_today': Attendance.objects.filter(
            date=timezone.now().date(), status='absent'
        ).count(),
    }

    paginator = Paginator(attendances, 30)
    page_obj = paginator.get_page(request.GET.get('page', 1))

    employees = Employee.objects.filter(is_active=True)

    context = {
        'page_obj': page_obj,
        'stats': stats,
        'from_date': from_date,
        'to_date': to_date,
        'current_employee': employee,
        'current_status': status,
        'employees': employees,
        'status_choices': Attendance.STATUS_CHOICES,
    }
    return render(request, 'hr/attendance_list.html', context)

@login_required
@require_permission('hr.attendance')
def attendance_report(request):
    import jdatetime
    from datetime import timedelta
    from django.db.models import Count, Q, Sum
    from django.utils import timezone

    now = timezone.now()
    j_now = jdatetime.date.fromgregorian(date=now.date())

    # ─── انتخاب سال/ماه از query ───
    try:
        selected_year = int(request.GET.get('year', j_now.year))
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        selected_year = j_now.year

    try:
        selected_month_num = int(request.GET.get('month_num', j_now.month))
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        selected_month_num = j_now.month

    if not (1 <= selected_month_num <= 12):
        selected_month_num = j_now.month

    # ─── بازه‌ی ماه شمسی ───
    month_start = jdatetime.date(selected_year, selected_month_num, 1).togregorian()
    if selected_month_num == 12:
        next_month = jdatetime.date(selected_year + 1, 1, 1)
    else:
        next_month = jdatetime.date(selected_year, selected_month_num + 1, 1)
    month_end = next_month.togregorian() - timedelta(days=1)

    # ─── لیست‌های dropdown ───
    year_choices = list(range(j_now.year - 3, j_now.year + 2))
    month_choices = [
        (1, 'فروردین'),
        (2, 'اردیبهشت'),
        (3, 'خرداد'),
        (4, 'تیر'),
        (5, 'مرداد'),
        (6, 'شهریور'),
        (7, 'مهر'),
        (8, 'آبان'),
        (9, 'آذر'),
        (10, 'دی'),
        (11, 'بهمن'),
        (12, 'اسفند'),
    ]

    employees = list(Employee.objects.filter(is_active=True))
    employee_ids = [e.pk for e in employees]

    # ═══ بهینه‌سازی: ۲ کوئری کل ═══
    base_qs = Attendance.objects.filter(
        date__gte=month_start,
        date__lte=month_end,
        employee_id__in=employee_ids,
    )

    counts_qs = base_qs.values('employee_id').annotate(
        total_days=Count('id'),
        present=Count('id', filter=Q(status='present')),
        late=Count('id', filter=Q(status='late')),
        absent=Count('id', filter=Q(status='absent')),
        leave=Count('id', filter=Q(status='leave')),
    )
    counts_map = {row['employee_id']: row for row in counts_qs}

    hours_map = {}
    for rec in base_qs.only('employee_id', 'check_in', 'check_out'):
        wh = rec.work_hours
        if wh:
            hours_map[rec.employee_id] = hours_map.get(rec.employee_id, 0) + wh

    report = []
    for emp in employees:
        c = counts_map.get(emp.pk, {})
        report.append({
            'employee': emp,
            'total_days': c.get('total_days', 0),
            'present': c.get('present', 0),
            'late': c.get('late', 0),
            'absent': c.get('absent', 0),
            'leave': c.get('leave', 0),
            'total_hours': round(hours_map.get(emp.pk, 0), 1),
        })

    context = {
        'report': report,
        'month_start': month_start,
        'month_end': month_end,
        'selected_year': selected_year,
        'selected_month_num': selected_month_num,
        'year_choices': year_choices,
        'month_choices': month_choices,
    }
    return render(request, 'hr/attendance_report.html', context)

# پروفایل من
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════

@login_required
def my_profile(request):
    from django_otp.plugins.otp_totp.models import TOTPDevice
    from django_otp.plugins.otp_static.models import StaticDevice

    try:
        employee = request.user.employee_profile
    except Employee.DoesNotExist:
        messages.warning(request, 'برای حساب کاربری شما پروفایل پرسنلی ثبت نشده است.')
        return redirect('dashboard:home')

    calls_count = request.user.calls.count()
    invoices_count = request.user.created_invoices.count()
    created_customers_count = request.user.created_customers.count()

    open_tasks = employee.tasks.filter(
        status__in=['pending', 'in_progress']
    ).order_by('due_date')

    done_tasks = employee.tasks.filter(
        status='done'
    ).order_by('-completed_at')[:5]

    # ═══ 2FA status ═══
    totp_device = TOTPDevice.objects.filter(user=request.user, confirmed=True).first()
    has_2fa = totp_device is not None

    recovery_codes_count = 0
    if has_2fa:
        static_device = StaticDevice.objects.filter(user=request.user).first()
        if static_device:
            recovery_codes_count = static_device.token_set.count()

    context = {
        'employee': employee,
        'open_tasks': open_tasks,
        'done_tasks': done_tasks,
        'calls_count': calls_count,
        'invoices_count': invoices_count,
        'created_customers_count': created_customers_count,
        # 2FA
        'has_2fa': has_2fa,
        'recovery_codes_count': recovery_codes_count,
    }
    return render(request, 'hr/my_profile.html', context)

User = get_user_model()
u = User.objects.filter(is_superuser=True).first()
if u is None:
    print('⚠️ superuser نیست')
    sys.exit(1)

print('─' * 70)

client.force_login(u)


def measure(label, url):
    with CaptureQueriesContext(connection) as ctx:
        try:
            r = client.get(url)
            status = r.status_code
        except Exception as e:
            status = f'ERR: {type(e).__name__}: {e}'
    print(f'{label:30s} | queries={len(ctx.captured_queries):4d} | status={status}')


# ═══ اضافه کردن testserver به ALLOWED_HOSTS برای این اسکریپت ═══

    try:
        measure('dashboard home', reverse('dashboard:home'))
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'dashboard skip: {e}')

    except Exception as e:
        print(f'attendance skip: {e}')

    from products.models import Product

        except Exception as e:

    try:

    except Exception as e:
        print(f'product list skip: {e}')

from django.contrib import admin, messages

from .models import Product, StockMovement, Category


@admin.register(Category)
class CategoryAdmin(admin.ModelAdmin):
    list_display = ('icon', 'name', 'slug', 'order', 'is_active', 'products_count', 'created_at')
    list_filter = ('is_active', 'created_at')
    search_fields = ('name', 'slug', 'description')
    ordering = ('order', 'name')
    list_editable = ('order', 'is_active')

    fieldsets = (
        ('اطلاعات اصلی', {
            'fields': ('name', 'slug', 'icon', 'description')
        }),
        ('تنظیمات', {
            'fields': ('order', 'is_active')
        }),
    )

    def products_count(self, obj):
        return obj.products_count
    products_count.short_description = 'تعداد کالا'


@admin.register(Product)
class ProductAdmin(admin.ModelAdmin):
    list_display = ('name', 'code', 'category', 'price', 'stock',
                    'is_active', 'is_deleted', 'created_at')
    list_filter = ('category', 'unit', 'is_active', 'is_deleted')
    search_fields = ('name', 'code', 'description')
    ordering = ('-created_at',)
    autocomplete_fields = ['category']

    fieldsets = (
        ('اطلاعات اصلی', {
            'fields': ('name', 'code', 'category', 'unit', 'is_active')
        }),
        ('قیمت‌ها', {
            'fields': ('price', 'cost_price')
        }),
        ('موجودی', {
            'fields': ('stock', 'min_stock')
        }),
        ('توضیحات', {
            'fields': ('description',)
        }),
        ('وضعیت حذف', {
            'fields': ('is_deleted', 'deleted_at'),
            'classes': ('collapse',),
        }),
    )
    readonly_fields = ('created_at', 'updated_at', 'deleted_at')

    actions = ['soft_delete_selected', 'restore_selected', 'hard_delete_selected']

    def get_queryset(self, request):
        return Product.all_objects.all()

    @admin.action(description='حذف نرم (Soft Delete)')
    def soft_delete_selected(self, request, queryset):
        count = 0
        for product in queryset.filter(is_deleted=False):
            product.delete()
            count += 1
        self.message_user(request, f'{count} کالا حذف نرم شد.', messages.SUCCESS)

    @admin.action(description='بازگرداندن')
    def restore_selected(self, request, queryset):
        count = 0
        for product in queryset.filter(is_deleted=True):
            product.restore()
            count += 1
        self.message_user(request, f'{count} کالا بازگردانده شد.', messages.SUCCESS)

    @admin.action(description='حذف کامل (خطرناک!)')
    def hard_delete_selected(self, request, queryset):
        try:
            count = 0
            for product in queryset:
                product.hard_delete()
                count += 1
            self.message_user(request, f'{count} کالا کامل حذف شد.', messages.WARNING)
        except Exception as e:
            self.message_user(request, f'خطا: {e}', messages.ERROR)


@admin.register(StockMovement)
class StockMovementAdmin(admin.ModelAdmin):

    list_filter = ('movement_type', 'reference_type', 'created_at')
    search_fields = ('product__name', 'product__code', 'reference_note', 'note')
    date_hierarchy = 'created_at'
    ordering = ('-created_at',)
    readonly_fields = ('product', 'movement_type', 'quantity', 'stock_before',
                       'stock_after', 'reference_type', 'reference_id',
                       'reference_note', 'note', 'created_by', 'created_at')

    def has_add_permission(self, request):
        return False

    def has_delete_permission(self, request, obj=None):
        return False

    def get_queryset(self, request):
        return StockMovement.objects.select_related('product', 'created_by')

"""ورود کالاها از Excel — فاز ۷.۸"""
from crm.excel_utils import (
    build_xlsx, normalize_digits, parse_int, read_xlsx, resolve_choice,
)
from .models import Category, Product


PRODUCT_HEADER_MAP = {
    'نام کالا': 'name',
    'کد کالا': 'code',
    'دسته‌بندی': 'category',
    'واحد': 'unit',
    'قیمت فروش': 'price',
    'قیمت خرید': 'cost_price',
    'موجودی': 'stock',
    'حداقل موجودی': 'min_stock',
    'توضیحات': 'description',
}

REQUIRED_COLUMNS = ['نام کالا', 'کد کالا', 'دسته‌بندی']


def parse_product_excel(file_obj, max_rows=2000):
    """Returns dict با rows/header_errors/total/valid/invalid"""
    data_rows, missing = read_xlsx(file_obj, PRODUCT_HEADER_MAP, max_rows=max_rows)

    header_errors = [col for col in REQUIRED_COLUMNS if col in missing]
    if header_errors:
        return {
            'rows': [],
            'header_errors': header_errors,
            'total': 0, 'valid': 0, 'invalid': 0,
        }

    seen_codes = {}
    rows = []
    valid_count = 0

    for raw in data_rows:
        cleaned, errors = _validate_product_row(raw, seen_codes)
        is_valid = len(errors) == 0
        if is_valid:
            valid_count += 1
        rows.append({
            'row_num': raw['_row_num'],
            'data': cleaned,
            'raw': {k: raw.get(k) for k in PRODUCT_HEADER_MAP.values()},
            'errors': errors,
            'is_valid': is_valid,
        })

    return {
        'rows': rows,
        'header_errors': [],
        'total': len(rows),
        'valid': valid_count,
        'invalid': len(rows) - valid_count,
    }


def _validate_product_row(raw, seen_codes):
    errors = []
    cleaned = {}

    # ─── نام ───
    name = str(raw.get('name') or '').strip()
    if not name:
        errors.append('نام کالا الزامی است')
    elif len(name) > 200:
        errors.append('نام کالا بیش از ۲۰۰ کاراکتر است')
    cleaned['name'] = name

    # ─── کد ───
    code = normalize_digits(raw.get('code')).replace(' ', '')
    if not code:
        errors.append('کد کالا الزامی است')
    elif len(code) > 50:
        errors.append('کد کالا بیش از ۵۰ کاراکتر است')
    elif code in seen_codes:
        errors.append(f'کد کالا تکراری در فایل (ردیف {seen_codes[code]})')
    else:
        seen_codes[code] = raw['_row_num']
        if Product.all_objects.filter(code=code).exists():
            errors.append('کد کالا قبلاً در سیستم ثبت شده')
    cleaned['code'] = code

    # ─── دسته‌بندی ───
    cat_raw = str(raw.get('category') or '').strip()
    category = None
    if not cat_raw:
        errors.append('دسته‌بندی الزامی است')
    else:
        category = (
            Category.objects.filter(slug=cat_raw).first()
            or Category.objects.filter(name=cat_raw).first()
        )
        if not category:
            errors.append(f'دسته‌بندی «{cat_raw}» یافت نشد')
    cleaned['category'] = category

    # ─── واحد ───
    cleaned['unit'] = resolve_choice(
        raw.get('unit'), Product.UNIT_CHOICES, default='عدد',
    )

    # ─── قیمت فروش ───
    price = parse_int(raw.get('price'), default=0)
    if price is None:
        price = 0
    if price < 0:
        errors.append('قیمت فروش نمی‌تواند منفی باشد')
        price = 0
    cleaned['price'] = price

    # ─── قیمت خرید ───
    cost_price = parse_int(raw.get('cost_price'), default=0)
    if cost_price is None:
        cost_price = 0
    if cost_price < 0:
        errors.append('قیمت خرید نمی‌تواند منفی باشد')
        cost_price = 0
    cleaned['cost_price'] = cost_price

    # ─── موجودی ───
    stock = parse_int(raw.get('stock'), default=0)
    if stock is None:
        stock = 0
    cleaned['stock'] = stock

    # ─── حداقل موجودی ───
    min_stock = parse_int(raw.get('min_stock'), default=0)
    if min_stock is None:
        min_stock = 0
    if min_stock < 0:
        errors.append('حداقل موجودی نمی‌تواند منفی باشد')
        min_stock = 0
    cleaned['min_stock'] = min_stock

    # ─── توضیحات ───
    cleaned['description'] = str(raw.get('description') or '').strip() or None

    return cleaned, errors


def save_valid_products(rows, user):
    """ذخیره‌ی فقط ردیف‌های معتبر. موجودی اولیه → StockMovement"""
    created = 0
    skipped = 0
    errors = []

    for row in rows:
        if not row['is_valid']:
            skipped += 1
            continue
        try:
            data = dict(row['data'])
            initial_stock = data.pop('stock', 0)
            product = Product.objects.create(**data)

            if initial_stock and initial_stock != 0:
                product.change_stock(
                    initial_stock,
                    movement_type='in',
                    user=user,
                    reference_type='manual',
                    reference_note='ورود اولیه از Excel',
                )
            created += 1
        except Exception as e:
            skipped += 1
            errors.append(f"ردیف {row['row_num']}: {e}")

    return {'created': created, 'skipped': skipped, 'errors': errors}


def build_product_template():
    """قالب Excel کالاها — با شیت راهنمای مقادیر مجاز"""
    headers = list(PRODUCT_HEADER_MAP.keys())
    sample = [
        'گوشی موبایل', 'MOB-001', 'mobile', 'عدد',
        '10000000', '8000000', '10', '2', 'توضیحات نمونه',
    ]
    notes = [
        'راهنمای تکمیل:',
        '• ستون‌های «نام کالا»، «کد کالا» و «دسته‌بندی» الزامی هستند.',
        '• دسته‌بندی: نام یا slug دسته — به شیت «راهنما» مراجعه کنید.',
        '• اعداد می‌توانند با کاما یا فارسی باشند.',
        '• موجودی اولیه به‌عنوان یک StockMovement «ورود» ثبت می‌شود.',
        '• کد کالا باید یکتا باشد و در سیستم ثبت نشده باشد.',
    ]

    # ─── لیست دسته‌بندی‌های فعال ───
    categories = Category.objects.filter(is_active=True).order_by('order', 'name')
    cat_items = []
    for c in categories:
        cat_items.append((c.slug, f"{c.icon} {c.name}"))
    if not cat_items:
        cat_items.append(('—', 'هیچ دسته‌بندی فعالی تعریف نشده'))

    choices_sections = [
        {
            'title': 'دسته‌بندی (ستون: دسته‌بندی)',
            'column': 'دسته‌بندی',
            'items': cat_items,
        },
        {
            'title': 'واحد کالا (ستون: واحد)',
            'column': 'واحد',
            'items': list(Product.UNIT_CHOICES),
        },
    ]

    return build_xlsx(
        headers,
        sample_row=sample,
        notes=notes,
        choices_sections=choices_sections,
    )

import re
from django import forms

from crm.duplicate_check import (
    find_exact_match, find_similar_matches,
    normalize_code, normalize_text,
)
from .models import Product, Category


class ProductForm(forms.ModelForm):
    """فرم کالا — با سیستم جامع تشخیص تکراری"""

    class Meta:
        model = Product
        fields = [
            'name', 'code', 'category', 'unit',
            'price', 'cost_price', 'stock', 'min_stock',
            'description', 'is_active',
        ]
        widgets = {
            'name': forms.TextInput(attrs={'class': 'w-full px-4 py-2.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm', 'placeholder': 'مثلاً iPhone 15 Pro Max'}),
            'code': forms.TextInput(attrs={'class': 'w-full px-4 py-2.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm', 'placeholder': 'مثلاً IPH15PM-256', 'dir': 'ltr'}),
            'category': forms.Select(attrs={'class': 'w-full px-4 py-2.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm'}),
            'unit': forms.Select(attrs={'class': 'w-full px-4 py-2.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm'}),
            'price': forms.NumberInput(attrs={'class': 'w-full px-4 py-2.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm', 'placeholder': '0', 'dir': 'ltr', 'min': 0}),
            'cost_price': forms.NumberInput(attrs={'class': 'w-full px-4 py-2.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm', 'placeholder': '0', 'dir': 'ltr', 'min': 0}),
            'stock': forms.NumberInput(attrs={'class': 'w-full px-4 py-2.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm', 'placeholder': '0', 'dir': 'ltr', 'min': 0}),
            'min_stock': forms.NumberInput(attrs={'class': 'w-full px-4 py-2.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm', 'placeholder': '0', 'dir': 'ltr', 'min': 0}),
            'description': forms.Textarea(attrs={'class': 'w-full px-4 py-2.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm', 'rows': 3, 'placeholder': 'توضیحات کالا'}),
            'is_active': forms.CheckboxInput(attrs={'class': 'w-4 h-4 text-blue-600 border-gray-300 rounded focus:ring-blue-500'}),
        }

    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        self.duplicate_warnings = []
        self.fields['category'].queryset = Category.objects.filter(is_active=True)
        self.fields['category'].empty_label = '— انتخاب دسته —'

    def clean_code(self):
        return normalize_code(self.cleaned_data.get('code'))

    def clean(self):
        cleaned = super().clean()
        self.duplicate_warnings = []
        exclude_pk = self.instance.pk if self.instance and self.instance.pk else None

        # ─── Exact block: code ───
        code = cleaned.get('code')
        if code:
            existing = find_exact_match(Product, 'code', code, normalize_code, exclude_pk)
            if existing:
                self.add_error('code', f'⛔ کد کالا «{code}» قبلاً برای «{existing.name}» ثبت شده است.')

        # ─── Similar warn: name ───
        name = cleaned.get('name')
        if name:
            for obj, ratio in find_similar_matches(Product, 'name', name, normalize_text, exclude_pk=exclude_pk):
                self.duplicate_warnings.append({
                    'field': 'name', 'label': 'نام کالا',
                    'value': name, 'match': obj, 'ratio': round(ratio * 100, 1),
                })

        return cleaned


class CategoryForm(forms.ModelForm):
    """فرم دسته‌بندی — با سیستم جامع تشخیص تکراری"""

    class Meta:
        model = Category
        fields = ['name', 'slug', 'icon', 'description', 'order', 'is_active']
        widgets = {
            'name': forms.TextInput(attrs={'class': 'w-full px-4 py-2.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm', 'placeholder': 'مثلاً: موبایل و تبلت'}),
            'slug': forms.TextInput(attrs={'class': 'w-full px-4 py-2.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm', 'placeholder': 'mobile', 'dir': 'ltr'}),
            'icon': forms.TextInput(attrs={'class': 'w-full px-4 py-2.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm', 'placeholder': '📱', 'maxlength': '10'}),
            'description': forms.Textarea(attrs={'class': 'w-full px-4 py-2.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm', 'rows': 3, 'placeholder': 'توضیحات (اختیاری)'}),
            'order': forms.NumberInput(attrs={'class': 'w-full px-4 py-2.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm', 'min': 0, 'dir': 'ltr'}),
            'is_active': forms.CheckboxInput(attrs={'class': 'w-4 h-4 text-blue-600 border-gray-300 rounded focus:ring-blue-500'}),
        }

    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        self.duplicate_warnings = []

    def clean_slug(self):
        slug = self.cleaned_data.get('slug', '').strip().lower()
        if not re.match(r'^[a-z0-9\-_]+$', slug):
            raise forms.ValidationError('نام کوتاه باید فقط شامل حروف انگلیسی کوچک، اعداد، - و _ باشد.')
        return slug

    def clean(self):
        cleaned = super().clean()
        self.duplicate_warnings = []
        exclude_pk = self.instance.pk if self.instance and self.instance.pk else None

        # ─── Exact block: name ───
        name = cleaned.get('name')
        if name:
            existing = find_exact_match(Category, 'name', name, normalize_text, exclude_pk)
            if existing:
                self.add_error('name', f'⛔ دسته‌بندی با همین نام «{existing.name}» قبلاً ثبت شده است.')

        # ─── Similar warn: name ───
        if name:
            for obj, ratio in find_similar_matches(Category, 'name', name, normalize_text,
                                                    threshold=0.90, exclude_pk=exclude_pk):
                self.duplicate_warnings.append({
                    'field': 'name', 'label': 'نام دسته',
                    'value': name, 'match': obj, 'ratio': round(ratio * 100, 1),
                })

        return cleaned

from django.db import migrations


def create_default_categories(apps, schema_editor):
    """ساخت ۶ دسته‌ی پیش‌فرض"""
    Category = apps.get_model('products', 'Category')
    defaults = [
        ('mobile', '📱', 'موبایل و تبلت', 1),
        ('laptop', '💻', 'لپ‌تاپ و کامپیوتر', 2),
        ('accessory', '🎧', 'لوازم جانبی', 3),
        ('parts', '🔧', 'قطعات', 4),
        ('service', '🛠️', 'خدمات', 5),
        ('other', '📦', 'سایر', 99),
    ]
    for slug, icon, name, order in defaults:
        Category.objects.get_or_create(
            slug=slug,
            defaults={'name': name, 'icon': icon, 'order': order, 'is_active': True}
        )


def map_product_categories(apps, schema_editor):
    """کپی مقادیر category (رشته) به category_fk (FK)"""
    Product = apps.get_model('products', 'Product')
    Category = apps.get_model('products', 'Category')

    cat_map = {c.slug: c for c in Category.objects.all()}
    default_cat = cat_map.get('other')

    for product in Product.objects.all():
        old_slug = (product.category or '').strip()
        if old_slug and old_slug in cat_map:
            product.category_fk_id = cat_map[old_slug].id
        elif default_cat:
            product.category_fk_id = default_cat.id
        else:
            continue
        product.save(update_fields=['category_fk'])


def reverse_noop(apps, schema_editor):
    pass


class Migration(migrations.Migration):

    dependencies = [
        ('products', '0005_category_and_more'),
    ]

    operations = [
        migrations.RunPython(create_default_categories, reverse_noop),
        migrations.RunPython(map_product_categories, reverse_noop),
    ]

from django.db import models, transaction
from django.contrib.auth.models import User
from django.utils import timezone


class Category(models.Model):
    """دسته‌بندی کالا — قابل مدیریت از پنل ادمین"""

    name = models.CharField('نام دسته', max_length=100)
    slug = models.SlugField(
        'نام کوتاه (انگلیسی)', max_length=50, unique=True,
        help_text='مثلاً: mobile, laptop — فقط حروف انگلیسی، اعداد، - و _'
    )
    icon = models.CharField(
        'آیکون (ایموجی)', max_length=10, blank=True,
        help_text='مثلاً: 📱 💻 🎧'
    )
    description = models.TextField('توضیحات', blank=True, null=True)
    order = models.PositiveIntegerField(
        'ترتیب نمایش', default=0,
        help_text='عدد کمتر = بالاتر'
    )
    is_active = models.BooleanField('فعال', default=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField('تاریخ ایجاد', auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField('آخرین ویرایش', auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = 'دسته‌بندی'
        verbose_name_plural = 'دسته‌بندی‌ها'
        ordering = ['order', 'name']
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=['slug']),
            models.Index(fields=['is_active', 'order']),
        ]

    def __str__(self):
        return f'{self.icon} {self.name}'.strip()

    @property
    def products_count(self):
        # اگه از annotate اومده باشه، ازش بخون؛ وگرنه fallback
        if hasattr(self, '_products_count'):
            return self._products_count
        return self.products.count()


class ProductManager(models.Manager):
    """مدیر پیش‌فرض — فقط محصولات حذف‌نشده"""
    def get_queryset(self):
        return super().get_queryset().filter(is_deleted=False)


class Product(models.Model):
    """مدل کالا — برای انبار و فاکتور"""

    UNIT_CHOICES = [
        ('عدد', 'عدد'),
        ('کیلوگرم', 'کیلوگرم'),
        ('گرم', 'گرم'),
        ('متر', 'متر'),
        ('لیتر', 'لیتر'),
        ('بسته', 'بسته'),
        ('جعبه', 'جعبه'),
    ]

    # ═══ اطلاعات اصلی ═══
    name = models.CharField('نام کالا', max_length=200, db_index=True)
    code = models.CharField('کد کالا (SKU)', max_length=50, unique=True, db_index=True)

    category = models.ForeignKey(
        Category, on_delete=models.PROTECT,
        related_name='products', verbose_name='دسته‌بندی',
    )

    unit = models.CharField('واحد', max_length=20,
                             choices=UNIT_CHOICES, default='عدد')

    # ═══ قیمت‌ها ═══
    price = models.DecimalField('قیمت فروش (تومان)', max_digits=15, decimal_places=0, default=0)
    cost_price = models.DecimalField('قیمت خرید (تومان)', max_digits=15, decimal_places=0,
                                      default=0, help_text='قیمت خرید از تامین‌کننده')

    # ═══ موجودی ═══
    stock = models.IntegerField('موجودی فعلی', default=0)
    min_stock = models.IntegerField('حداقل موجودی (هشدار)', default=0,
                                     help_text='اگه موجودی کمتر از این شد، هشدار بده')

    # ═══ اطلاعات تکمیلی ═══
    description = models.TextField('توضیحات', blank=True, null=True)
    is_active = models.BooleanField('فعال', default=True)

    # ═══ Soft Delete ═══
    is_deleted = models.BooleanField('حذف‌شده', default=False, db_index=True)
    deleted_at = models.DateTimeField('تاریخ حذف', null=True, blank=True)

    # ═══ زمان‌ها ═══
    created_at = models.DateTimeField('تاریخ ایجاد', auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField('آخرین ویرایش', auto_now=True)

    # ═══ مدیرها ═══
    objects = ProductManager()
    all_objects = models.Manager()

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = 'کالا'
        verbose_name_plural = 'کالاها'
        ordering = ['-created_at']
        base_manager_name = 'all_objects'
        default_manager_name = 'objects'
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=['code']),
        ]

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.name} ({self.code})"

    @property
    def is_low_stock(self):
        return self.stock <= self.min_stock

    @property
    def stock_status(self):
        if self.stock == 0:
            return 'out'
        elif self.stock <= self.min_stock:
            return 'low'
        return 'ok'

    @property
    def profit_margin(self):
        if self.cost_price and self.cost_price > 0:
            return round((float(self.price) - float(self.cost_price)) / float(self.cost_price) * 100, 1)
        return 0

    @property
    def is_used(self):
        return self.invoice_items.exists() or self.stock_movements.exists()

    def delete(self, using=None, keep_parents=False):
        self.is_deleted = True
        self.deleted_at = timezone.now()
        self.is_active = False
        self.save(update_fields=['is_deleted', 'deleted_at', 'is_active', 'updated_at'])

    def hard_delete(self):
        return super().delete()

    def restore(self):
        self.is_deleted = False
        self.deleted_at = None
        self.is_active = True
        self.save(update_fields=['is_deleted', 'deleted_at', 'is_active', 'updated_at'])

    def change_stock(self, quantity, movement_type, user=None,
                     reference_type='manual', reference_id=None,
                     reference_note=None, note=None):
        if not isinstance(quantity, int):
            raise ValueError('quantity باید عدد صحیح باشد')

        with transaction.atomic():
            locked = Product.all_objects.select_for_update().get(pk=self.pk)
            before = locked.stock
            after = before + quantity

            if after < 0:
                raise ValueError(
                    f'موجودی «{locked.name}» کافی نیست. '
                    f'موجودی فعلی: {before}، درخواستی: {abs(quantity)}'
                )

            locked.stock = after
            locked.save(update_fields=['stock', 'updated_at'])

            StockMovement.objects.create(
                product=locked,
                movement_type=movement_type,
                quantity=quantity,
                stock_before=before,
                stock_after=after,
                reference_type=reference_type,
                reference_id=reference_id,
                reference_note=reference_note,
                note=note,
                created_by=user,
            )

            self.stock = after
            return after


class StockMovement(models.Model):
    """لاگ گردش موجودی"""

    MOVEMENT_TYPE_CHOICES = [
        ('in', 'ورود'),
        ('out', 'خروج'),
        ('adjust', 'تعدیل'),
        ('cancel', 'برگشت از لغو'),
    ]

    REFERENCE_TYPE_CHOICES = [
        ('invoice', 'فاکتور'),
        ('manual', 'دستی'),
        ('purchase', 'خرید'),
        ('return', 'برگشت'),
    ]

    product = models.ForeignKey(
        Product, on_delete=models.PROTECT,
        related_name='stock_movements', verbose_name='کالا'
    )
    movement_type = models.CharField(
        'نوع گردش', max_length=10,
        choices=MOVEMENT_TYPE_CHOICES, db_index=True
    )
    quantity = models.IntegerField('مقدار')
    stock_before = models.IntegerField('موجودی قبل')
    stock_after = models.IntegerField('موجودی بعد')

    reference_type = models.CharField(
        'مرجع', max_length=20,
        choices=REFERENCE_TYPE_CHOICES, default='manual'
    )
    reference_id = models.PositiveIntegerField('شناسه مرجع', null=True, blank=True)
    reference_note = models.CharField('توضیح مرجع', max_length=200, blank=True, null=True)

    note = models.TextField('یادداشت', blank=True, null=True)
    created_by = models.ForeignKey(
        User, on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True,
        related_name='stock_movements', verbose_name='ثبت‌کننده'
    )
    created_at = models.DateTimeField('تاریخ ثبت', auto_now_add=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = 'گردش موجودی'
        verbose_name_plural = 'گردش‌های موجودی'
        ordering = ['-created_at']
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=['product', '-created_at']),
            models.Index(fields=['reference_type', 'reference_id']),
        ]

    def __str__(self):
        sign = '+' if self.quantity >= 0 else ''
        return f"{self.product.code} — {self.get_movement_type_display()} {sign}{self.quantity}"

    @property
    def is_increase(self):
        return self.quantity > 0

    @property
    def quantity_display(self):
        return f'{self.quantity:+d}'

"""
تست‌های products — StockMovement و change_stock
"""
from django.test import TestCase
from django.contrib.auth.models import User
from django.db import transaction

from .models import Product, StockMovement, Category


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# تست Product.change_stock
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
class ChangeStockTest(TestCase):

    @classmethod
    def setUpTestData(cls):
        cls.user = User.objects.create_user('stock_user', password='t123456')
        cls.category = Category.objects.create(
            name='دسته تستی', slug='test-stock-cat',
        )
        cls.product = Product.objects.create(
            name='کالای تستی',
            code='TEST-001',
            category=cls.category,
            price=100000,
            cost_price=80000,
            stock=50,
        )

    def test_increase_stock(self):
        """افزایش موجودی و ثبت لاگ"""
        result = self.product.change_stock(
            quantity=+10,
            movement_type='in',
            user=self.user,
            reference_type='purchase',
            reference_note='خرید',
        )
        self.assertEqual(result, 60)
        self.product.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(self.product.stock, 60)

        movement = StockMovement.objects.latest('created_at')
        self.assertEqual(movement.movement_type, 'in')
        self.assertEqual(movement.quantity, 10)
        self.assertEqual(movement.stock_before, 50)
        self.assertEqual(movement.stock_after, 60)
        self.assertEqual(movement.created_by, self.user)

    def test_decrease_stock(self):
        """کاهش موجودی"""
        result = self.product.change_stock(
            quantity=-5,
            movement_type='out',
            user=self.user,
        )
        self.assertEqual(result, 45)
        self.product.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(self.product.stock, 45)

    def test_cannot_go_negative(self):
        """اگر موجودی کافی نباشد ValueError می‌دهد"""
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as ctx:
            self.product.change_stock(
                quantity=-100,
                movement_type='out',
                user=self.user,
            )
        self.assertIn('کافی نیست', str(ctx.exception))

        # موجودی تغییر نکرده
        self.product.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(self.product.stock, 50)

        # هیچ لاگی ثبت نشده
        self.assertEqual(StockMovement.objects.count(), 0)

    def test_exact_zero_allowed(self):
        """صفر شدن مجاز است"""
        result = self.product.change_stock(
            quantity=-50,
            movement_type='out',
            user=self.user,
        )
        self.assertEqual(result, 0)

    def test_quantity_must_be_int(self):
        """quantity باید int باشد"""
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.product.change_stock(
                quantity=1.5,
                movement_type='in',
                user=self.user,
            )
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.product.change_stock(
                quantity='10',
                movement_type='in',
                user=self.user,
            )

    def test_multiple_movements_have_correct_chain(self):
        """زنجیره‌ی درست before/after"""
        self.product.change_stock(+20, 'in', user=self.user)
        self.product.change_stock(-5, 'out', user=self.user)
        self.product.change_stock(+10, 'in', user=self.user)

        movements = list(StockMovement.objects.order_by('created_at'))
        self.assertEqual(len(movements), 3)

        self.assertEqual(movements[0].stock_before, 50)
        self.assertEqual(movements[0].stock_after, 70)

        self.assertEqual(movements[1].stock_before, 70)
        self.assertEqual(movements[1].stock_after, 65)

        self.assertEqual(movements[2].stock_before, 65)
        self.assertEqual(movements[2].stock_after, 75)

        self.product.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(self.product.stock, 75)

    def test_optional_fields(self):
        """فیلدهای اختیاری None می‌مونن اگر پاس نشن"""
        self.product.change_stock(+5, 'in')
        movement = StockMovement.objects.latest('created_at')
        self.assertIsNone(movement.created_by)
        self.assertIsNone(movement.reference_id)
        self.assertIsNone(movement.reference_note)
        self.assertEqual(movement.reference_type, 'manual')

    def test_self_stock_updated(self):
        """بعد از change_stock، self.stock هم آپدیت شده"""
        self.product.change_stock(+10, 'in', user=self.user)
        self.assertEqual(self.product.stock, 60)

class StockMovementModelTest(TestCase):

    @classmethod
    def setUpTestData(cls):
        cls.category = Category.objects.create(
            name='دسته تستی ۲', slug='test-sm-cat',
        )
        cls.product = Product.objects.create(
            name='کالا',
            code='SM-001',
            category=cls.category,
            price=50000,
            stock=100,
        )

    def test_is_increase_property(self):
        m1 = StockMovement.objects.create(
            product=self.product,
            movement_type='in',
            quantity=10,
            stock_before=90,
            stock_after=100,
        )
        self.assertTrue(m1.is_increase)
        self.assertEqual(m1.quantity_display, '+10')

        m2 = StockMovement.objects.create(
            product=self.product,
            movement_type='out',
            quantity=-5,
            stock_before=100,
            stock_after=95,
        )
        self.assertFalse(m2.is_increase)
        self.assertEqual(m2.quantity_display, '-5')

    def test_str_representation(self):
        m = StockMovement.objects.create(
            product=self.product,
            movement_type='out',
            quantity=-3,
            stock_before=100,
            stock_after=97,
        )
        s = str(m)
        self.assertIn('SM-001', s)
        self.assertIn('-3', s)

class ProductDuplicateTest(TestCase):

    @classmethod
    def setUpTestData(cls):
        cls.category = Category.objects.create(
            name='دسته اصلی', slug='main-cat',
        )
        cls.existing = Product.objects.create(
            name='کالای موجود', code='EXIST-001',
            category=cls.category, price=100000, stock=10,
        )

    def test_unique_code_is_valid(self):
        from .forms import ProductForm
        form = ProductForm(data={
            'name': 'کالای جدید',
            'code': 'NEW-001',
            'category': self.category.pk,
            'unit': 'عدد',
            'price': 50000,
            'cost_price': 40000,
            'stock': 5,
            'min_stock': 1,
            'is_active': True,
        })
        self.assertTrue(form.is_valid(), form.errors)

    def test_duplicate_code_blocks_save(self):
        from .forms import ProductForm
        form = ProductForm(data={
            'name': 'کالای جدید',
            'code': 'EXIST-001',
            'category': self.category.pk,
            'unit': 'عدد',
            'price': 50000,
            'stock': 5,
            'is_active': True,
        })
        self.assertFalse(form.is_valid())
        self.assertIn('code', form.errors)
        self.assertIn('کالای موجود', str(form.errors['code']))

    def test_code_normalization_persian_digits(self):
        """کد با ارقام فارسی → نرمال‌سازی و تشخیص duplicate"""
        from .forms import ProductForm
        form = ProductForm(data={
            'name': 'X',
            'code': 'EXIST-۰۰۱',   # ارقام فارسی
            'category': self.category.pk,
            'unit': 'عدد',
            'price': 1000,
            'stock': 0,
            'is_active': True,
        })
        self.assertFalse(form.is_valid())
        self.assertIn('code', form.errors)

    def test_code_normalization_spaces(self):
        """کد با فاصله → نرمال‌سازی"""
        from .forms import ProductForm
        form = ProductForm(data={
            'name': 'X',
            'code': 'EXIST - 001',
            'category': self.category.pk,
            'unit': 'عدد',
            'price': 1000,
            'stock': 0,
            'is_active': True,
        })
        self.assertFalse(form.is_valid())
        self.assertIn('code', form.errors)

    def test_similar_name_shows_warning(self):
        """نام کاملاً مشابه → warning نه block (چون code یکتاست)"""
        from .forms import ProductForm
        form = ProductForm(data={
            'name': 'کالای موجود',   # exact same name
            'code': 'DIFFERENT-001',
            'category': self.category.pk,
            'unit': 'عدد',
            'price': 1000,
            'cost_price': 500,
            'stock': 0,
            'min_stock': 0,
            'is_active': True,
        })
        # باید valid باشه (code یکتاست)
        self.assertTrue(form.is_valid(), form.errors)
        # ولی warning برای نام
        name_warnings = [w for w in form.duplicate_warnings if w['field'] == 'name']
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(name_warnings), 1)

    def test_edit_self_keeps_code(self):
        """ویرایش خود کالا → block نکنه"""
        from .forms import ProductForm
        form = ProductForm(
            data={
                'name': 'کالای موجود ویرایش',
                'code': 'EXIST-001',
                'category': self.category.pk,
                'unit': 'عدد',
                'price': 200000,
                'cost_price': 150000,
                'stock': 10,
                'min_stock': 2,
                'is_active': True,
            },
            instance=self.existing,
        )
        self.assertTrue(form.is_valid(), form.errors)

from django.shortcuts import render, get_object_or_404, redirect
from django.contrib.auth.decorators import login_required
from django.contrib import messages
from django.core.paginator import Paginator
from django.db.models import Q, Sum, F, Count
from accounts.permissions import require_permission, has_permission
from .models import Product, StockMovement, Category
from .forms import ProductForm, CategoryForm
from crm.duplicate_check import show_duplicate_warnings

@login_required
@require_permission('products.view')
def product_list(request):
    show_deleted = request.GET.get('show') == 'deleted'
    can_see_deleted = has_permission(request.user, 'products.delete')

    if show_deleted and not can_see_deleted:
        show_deleted = False

    if show_deleted:
        products = Product.all_objects.filter(is_deleted=True).select_related('category')
    else:
        products = Product.objects.select_related('category').all()

    search = request.GET.get('q', '').strip()
    if search:
        products = products.filter(
            Q(name__icontains=search) |
            Q(code__icontains=search) |
            Q(description__icontains=search)
        )

    category_slug = request.GET.get('category', '')
    if category_slug:
        products = products.filter(category__slug=category_slug)

    status_filter = request.GET.get('status', '')
    if status_filter == 'active':
        products = products.filter(is_active=True)
    elif status_filter == 'inactive':
        products = products.filter(is_active=False)
    elif status_filter == 'low_stock':
        products = products.filter(stock__lte=F('min_stock'), stock__gt=0)
    elif status_filter == 'out_of_stock':
        products = products.filter(stock=0)

    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # بهینه‌سازی N+1: قبلاً ۵ کوئری count جدا → الان ۱ + ۱
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    stats = Product.objects.aggregate(
        total=Count('id'),
        active=Count('id', filter=Q(is_active=True)),
        low_stock=Count('id', filter=Q(stock__lte=F('min_stock'), stock__gt=0)),
        out_of_stock=Count('id', filter=Q(stock=0)),
    )
    stats['deleted'] = Product.all_objects.filter(is_deleted=True).count()

    paginator = Paginator(products, 20)
    page_obj = paginator.get_page(request.GET.get('page', 1))

    context = {
        'page_obj': page_obj,
        'stats': stats,
        'search': search,
        'current_category': category_slug,
        'current_status': status_filter,
        'show_deleted': show_deleted,
        # ═══ بهینه‌سازی N+1: جلوگیری از کوئری per-category در template ═══
        'categories': Category.objects.filter(is_active=True).annotate(
            _products_count=Count('products'),
        ),
    }
    return render(request, 'products/list.html', context)


@login_required
@require_permission('products.view')
def product_detail(request, pk):
    from sales.models import InvoiceItem
    product = get_object_or_404(Product.all_objects, pk=pk)

    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # بهینه‌سازی N+1: قبلاً ۳ کوئری filter + محاسبه‌ی sum در Python
    # الان: ۱ کوئری برای aggregate + ۱ کوئری برای recent_items
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    base_qs = InvoiceItem.objects.filter(
        product=product,
        invoice__status__in=['issued', 'paid'],
    )

    recent_items = (
        base_qs
        .select_related('invoice', 'invoice__customer')
        .order_by('-invoice__created_at')[:10]
    )

    totals = base_qs.aggregate(
        total_sold=Sum('quantity'),
        total_revenue=Sum('total_price'),
        invoices_count=Count('invoice', distinct=True),
    )

    context = {
        'product': product,
        'recent_items': recent_items,
        'total_sold': totals['total_sold'] or 0,
        'total_revenue': totals['total_revenue'] or 0,
        'invoices_count': totals['invoices_count'] or 0,
    }
    return render(request, 'products/detail.html', context)


@login_required
@require_permission('products.add')
def product_create(request):
    if request.method == 'POST':
        form = ProductForm(request.POST)
        if form.is_valid():
            product = form.save()
            show_duplicate_warnings(request, form)
            messages.success(request, f'کالای «{product.name}» اضافه شد.')
            return redirect('products:detail', pk=product.pk)
    else:
        form = ProductForm()

    return render(request, 'products/form.html', {
        'form': form,
        'title': 'افزودن کالای جدید',
        'submit_label': 'ذخیره کالا',
    })


@login_required
@require_permission('products.edit')
def product_edit(request, pk):
    product = get_object_or_404(Product.objects, pk=pk)
    if request.method == 'POST':
        form = ProductForm(request.POST, instance=product)
        if form.is_valid():
            form.save()
            show_duplicate_warnings(request, form)
            messages.success(request, 'اطلاعات کالا به‌روزرسانی شد.')
            return redirect('products:detail', pk=product.pk)
    else:
        form = ProductForm(instance=product)

    return render(request, 'products/form.html', {
        'form': form,
        'title': f'ویرایش کالا: {product.name}',
        'submit_label': 'ذخیره تغییرات',
        'product': product,
    })


@login_required
@require_permission('products.delete')
def product_delete(request, pk):
    product = get_object_or_404(Product.objects, pk=pk)

    if request.method == 'POST':
        name = product.name
        was_used = product.is_used
        product.delete()

        if was_used:
            messages.warning(
                request,
                f'کالای «{name}» حذف نرم شد. '
                'چون در فاکتور یا انبار استفاده شده، اطلاعاتش حفظ می‌شود.'
            )
        else:
            messages.success(request, f'کالای «{name}» حذف شد.')
        return redirect('products:list')

    return render(request, 'products/confirm_delete.html', {
        'product': product,
        'is_used': product.is_used,
    })


@login_required
@require_permission('products.delete')
def product_restore(request, pk):
    product = get_object_or_404(Product.all_objects, pk=pk, is_deleted=True)

    if request.method == 'POST':
        product.restore()
        messages.success(request, f'کالای «{product.name}» بازگردانده شد.')
        return redirect('products:detail', pk=product.pk)

    return render(request, 'products/restore.html', {'product': product})

@login_required
@require_permission('categories.view')
def category_list(request):
    categories = Category.objects.all().order_by('order', 'name')

    search = request.GET.get('q', '').strip()
    if search:
        categories = categories.filter(
            Q(name__icontains=search) |
            Q(slug__icontains=search) |
            Q(description__icontains=search)
        )

    status = request.GET.get('status', '')
    if status == 'active':
        categories = categories.filter(is_active=True)
    elif status == 'inactive':
        categories = categories.filter(is_active=False)

    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # بهینه‌سازی N+1: یک annotation برای همه‌ی products_count
    # (بدون این خط، هر ردیف یک کوئری COUNT جدا می‌زنه)
    # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    categories = categories.annotate(_products_count=Count('products'))

    stats = {
        'total': Category.objects.count(),
        'active': Category.objects.filter(is_active=True).count(),
        'inactive': Category.objects.filter(is_active=False).count(),
    }

    context = {
        'categories': categories,
        'stats': stats,
        'search': search,
        'current_status': status,
    }
    return render(request, 'products/category_list.html', context)


@login_required
@require_permission('categories.manage')
def category_create(request):
    if request.method == 'POST':
        form = CategoryForm(request.POST)
        if form.is_valid():
            category = form.save()
            show_duplicate_warnings(request, form)
            messages.success(request, f'دسته‌بندی «{category.name}» اضافه شد.')
            return redirect('products:category_list')
    else:
        last = Category.objects.order_by('-order').first()
        initial = {'order': (last.order + 1) if last else 1}
        form = CategoryForm(initial=initial)

    return render(request, 'products/category_form.html', {
        'form': form,
        'title': 'افزودن دسته‌بندی جدید',
        'submit_label': 'ذخیره',
        'is_create': True,
    })


@login_required
@require_permission('categories.manage')
def category_edit(request, pk):
    category = get_object_or_404(Category, pk=pk)

    if request.method == 'POST':
        form = CategoryForm(request.POST, instance=category)
        if form.is_valid():
            form.save()
            show_duplicate_warnings(request, form)
            messages.success(request, 'دسته‌بندی به‌روزرسانی شد.')
            return redirect('products:category_list')
    else:
        form = CategoryForm(instance=category)

    return render(request, 'products/category_form.html', {
        'form': form,
        'title': f'ویرایش: {category.name}',
        'submit_label': 'ذخیره تغییرات',
        'is_create': False,
        'category': category,
    })


@login_required
@require_permission('categories.manage')
def category_delete(request, pk):
    category = get_object_or_404(Category, pk=pk)
    products_count = category.products_count

    if request.method == 'POST':
        if products_count > 0:
            messages.error(
                request,
                f'این دسته دارای {products_count} کالا است و قابل حذف نیست. '
                'ابتدا کالاها را به دسته‌ی دیگری منتقل کنید یا دسته را غیرفعال کنید.'
            )
            return redirect('products:category_list')

        name = category.name
        category.delete()
        messages.success(request, f'دسته‌بندی «{name}» حذف شد.')
        return redirect('products:category_list')

    return render(request, 'products/category_confirm_delete.html', {
        'category': category,
        'products_count': products_count,
    })

# ورود از Excel — فاز ۷.۸
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
import uuid
from django.core.cache import cache
from django.http import HttpResponse

from crm.excel_utils import ExcelImportError
from .excel_import import (
    build_product_template,
    parse_product_excel,
    save_valid_products,
)


_CACHE_PREFIX = 'product_excel_import'
_CACHE_TIMEOUT = 30 * 60
_MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE = 5 * 1024 * 1024  # 5 MB


@login_required
@require_permission('products.add')
def product_excel_import(request):
    """آپلود فایل Excel کالاها"""
    if request.method == 'POST':
        file = request.FILES.get('excel_file')
        if not file:
            messages.error(request, 'فایلی انتخاب نشده است.')
            return redirect('products:excel_import')

        if not file.name.lower().endswith(('.xlsx', '.xlsm')):
            messages.error(request, 'فقط فایل‌های Excel (xlsx) پشتیبانی می‌شوند.')
            return redirect('products:excel_import')

        if file.size > _MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE:
            messages.error(request, 'حجم فایل نباید بیش از ۵ مگابایت باشد.')
            return redirect('products:excel_import')

        try:
            result = parse_product_excel(file)
        except ExcelImportError as e:
            messages.error(request, str(e))
            return redirect('products:excel_import')

        if result['header_errors']:
            messages.error(
                request,
                'ستون‌های الزامی زیر در فایل یافت نشد: '
                + '، '.join(result['header_errors']),
            )
            return redirect('products:excel_import')

        if not result['rows']:
            messages.warning(request, 'فایل خالی است یا سطری برای پردازش ندارد.')
            return redirect('products:excel_import')

        token = str(uuid.uuid4())
        cache.set(f'{_CACHE_PREFIX}:{token}', result, _CACHE_TIMEOUT)
        return redirect('products:excel_preview', token=token)

    return render(request, 'products/excel_import.html')


@login_required
@require_permission('products.add')
def product_excel_preview(request, token):
    """پیش‌نمایش و تأیید نهایی"""
    result = cache.get(f'{_CACHE_PREFIX}:{token}')
    if not result:
        messages.error(request, 'نشست منقضی شده. لطفاً فایل را دوباره بارگذاری کنید.')
        return redirect('products:excel_import')

    if request.method == 'POST':
        action = request.POST.get('action')

        if action == 'cancel':
            cache.delete(f'{_CACHE_PREFIX}:{token}')
            messages.info(request, 'ورود داده لغو شد.')
            return redirect('products:list')

        if action == 'confirm':
            save_result = save_valid_products(result['rows'], request.user)
            cache.delete(f'{_CACHE_PREFIX}:{token}')

            if save_result['created']:
                messages.success(
                    request,
                    f"{save_result['created']} کالا با موفقیت اضافه شد.",
                )
            if save_result['skipped']:
                messages.warning(
                    request,
                    f"{save_result['skipped']} ردیف نامعتبر یا خطادار نادیده گرفته شد.",
                )
            for err in save_result['errors'][:5]:
                messages.error(request, err)

            return redirect('products:list')

    return render(request, 'products/excel_preview.html', {
        'result': result,
        'token': token,
    })


@login_required
@require_permission('products.add')
def product_excel_template(request):
    """دانلود قالب Excel"""
    content = build_product_template()
    response = HttpResponse(
        content,
        content_type=(
            'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet'
        ),
    )
    response['Content-Disposition'] = 'attachment; filename="products-template.xlsx"'
    return response

import jdatetime
from datetime import datetime
from django import forms
from django.forms import inlineformset_factory
from django.utils import timezone
from customers.models import Customer
from products.models import Product
from .models import Invoice, InvoiceItem


class InvoiceForm(forms.ModelForm):
    """فرم سربرگ فاکتور"""

    # ⭐ تاریخ‌ها به‌عنوان CharField برای تقویم شمسی
    issue_date = forms.CharField(
        required=False,
        label='تاریخ صدور',
        widget=forms.TextInput(attrs={
            'class': 'w-full px-4 py-2.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm',
            'data-jdp': '',
            'data-jdp-time': 'false',
            'placeholder': '۱۴۰۵/۰۱/۱۵',
            'autocomplete': 'off',
        })
    )
    due_date = forms.CharField(
        required=False,
        label='مهلت پرداخت',
        widget=forms.TextInput(attrs={
            'class': 'w-full px-4 py-2.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm',
            'data-jdp': '',
            'data-jdp-time': 'false',
            'placeholder': '۱۴۰۵/۰۱/۱۵',
            'autocomplete': 'off',
        })
    )

    class Meta:
        model = Invoice
        fields = ['customer', 'status', 'payment_type', 'issue_date', 'due_date',
                  'discount', 'tax_percent', 'notes']
        widgets = {
            'customer': forms.Select(attrs={
                'class': 'w-full px-4 py-2.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm'
            }),
            'status': forms.Select(attrs={
                'class': 'w-full px-4 py-2.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm'
            }),
            'payment_type': forms.Select(attrs={
                'class': 'w-full px-4 py-2.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm'
            }),
            'discount': forms.NumberInput(attrs={
                'class': 'w-full px-4 py-2.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm',
                'placeholder': '0', 'min': 0, 'dir': 'ltr'
            }),
            'tax_percent': forms.NumberInput(attrs={
                'class': 'w-full px-4 py-2.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm',
                'placeholder': '9', 'min': 0, 'max': 100, 'step': '0.01', 'dir': 'ltr'
            }),
            'notes': forms.Textarea(attrs={
                'class': 'w-full px-4 py-2.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm',
                'rows': 3, 'placeholder': 'توضیحات فاکتور'
            }),
        }

    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)

        if self.instance and self.instance.pk and self.instance.issue_date:
            j = jdatetime.date.fromgregorian(date=self.instance.issue_date)
            self.initial['issue_date'] = j.strftime('%Y/%m/%d')
        else:
            j = jdatetime.date.fromgregorian(date=timezone.now().date())
            self.initial['issue_date'] = j.strftime('%Y/%m/%d')

        if self.instance and self.instance.pk and self.instance.due_date:
            j = jdatetime.date.fromgregorian(date=self.instance.due_date)
            self.initial['due_date'] = j.strftime('%Y/%m/%d')

    def _to_en(self, value):
        persian = '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'
        arabic = '٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩'
        for i, (p, a) in enumerate(zip(persian, arabic)):
            value = value.replace(p, str(i)).replace(a, str(i))
        return value

    def clean_issue_date(self):
        value = self.cleaned_data.get('issue_date')
        if not value:
            return timezone.now().date()
        if hasattr(value, 'year'):
            return value

        value = self._to_en(str(value).strip()).replace('-', '/').replace('.', '/')
        if ' ' in value:
            value = value.split(' ', 1)[0]

        try:
            y, m, d = map(int, value.split('/'))
            return jdatetime.date(y, m, d).togregorian()
        except (ValueError, AttributeError):
            raise forms.ValidationError('تاریخ معتبر نیست')

    def clean_due_date(self):
        value = self.cleaned_data.get('due_date')
        if not value:
            return None
        if hasattr(value, 'year'):
            return value

        value = self._to_en(str(value).strip()).replace('-', '/').replace('.', '/')
        if ' ' in value:
            value = value.split(' ', 1)[0]

        try:
            y, m, d = map(int, value.split('/'))
            return jdatetime.date(y, m, d).togregorian()
        except (ValueError, AttributeError):
            raise forms.ValidationError('تاریخ معتبر نیست')


# ═══ فرم قلم فاکتور — پشتیبانی از محصولات soft-deleted ═══
from django.db.models import Q


class InvoiceItemForm(forms.ModelForm):
    """فرم هر قلم فاکتور"""

    class Meta:
        model = InvoiceItem
        fields = ['product', 'quantity', 'unit_price']
        widgets = {
            'product': forms.Select(attrs={
                'class': 'item-product w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm',
            }),
            'quantity': forms.NumberInput(attrs={
                'class': 'item-qty w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm',
                'min': 1, 'placeholder': '1',
            }),
            'unit_price': forms.NumberInput(attrs={
                'class': 'item-price w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm',
                'min': 0, 'placeholder': '0', 'dir': 'ltr'
            }),
        }

    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)

        # اگه این قلم قبلاً ذخیره شده و محصولش soft-deleted شده،
        # محصول فعلی رو توی queryset نگه‌دار تا فرم معتبر بمونه
        if self.instance and self.instance.pk and self.instance.product_id:
            current_id = self.instance.product_id
            self.fields['product'].queryset = Product.all_objects.filter(
                Q(is_deleted=False) | Q(pk=current_id)
            )
        else:
            self.fields['product'].queryset = Product.objects.all()


InvoiceItemFormSet = inlineformset_factory(
    Invoice,
    InvoiceItem,
    form=InvoiceItemForm,
    extra=3,
    can_delete=True,
)

import jdatetime
from django.db import models, transaction
from django.contrib.auth.models import User
from django.utils import timezone
from customers.models import Customer
from products.models import Product


class Invoice(models.Model):
    """مدل فاکتور — سربرگ فاکتور"""

    STATUS_CHOICES = [
        ('draft', 'پیش‌نویس'),
        ('issued', 'صادر شده'),
        ('paid', 'پرداخت شده'),
        ('cancelled', 'لغو شده'),
    ]

    PAYMENT_TYPE_CHOICES = [
        ('cash', 'نقدی'),
        ('installment', 'اقساطی'),
        ('cheque', 'چکی'),
        ('card', 'کارت به کارت'),
        ('other', 'سایر'),
    ]

    # ═══ شماره و مشتری ═══
    number = models.CharField('شماره فاکتور', max_length=30, unique=True, db_index=True)
    customer = models.ForeignKey(
        Customer, on_delete=models.PROTECT,
        related_name='invoices', verbose_name='مشتری'
    )

    # ═══ وضعیت ═══
    status = models.CharField('وضعیت', max_length=20,
                              choices=STATUS_CHOICES, default='draft', db_index=True)
    payment_type = models.CharField('نوع پرداخت', max_length=20,
                                     choices=PAYMENT_TYPE_CHOICES, default='cash')

    # ═══ تاریخ‌ها ═══
    issue_date = models.DateField('تاریخ صدور', default=timezone.now)
    due_date = models.DateField('مهلت پرداخت', null=True, blank=True)

    # ═══ مالیات و تخفیف ═══
    discount = models.DecimalField('تخفیف (تومان)', max_digits=15, decimal_places=0, default=0)
    tax_percent = models.DecimalField('درصد مالیات', max_digits=5, decimal_places=2, default=9)
    tax_amount = models.DecimalField('مبلغ مالیات', max_digits=15, decimal_places=0, default=0)
    subtotal = models.DecimalField('جمع اقلام', max_digits=15, decimal_places=0, default=0)
    total = models.DecimalField('مبلغ نهایی', max_digits=15, decimal_places=0, default=0)

    # ═══ توضیحات ═══
    notes = models.TextField('توضیحات', blank=True, null=True)

    # ═══ مسئول ═══
    created_by = models.ForeignKey(
        User, on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True,
        related_name='created_invoices', verbose_name='ایجادکننده'
    )

    # ═══ زمان‌ها ═══
    created_at = models.DateTimeField('تاریخ ایجاد', auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField('آخرین ویرایش', auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = 'فاکتور'
        verbose_name_plural = 'فاکتورها'
        ordering = ['-created_at']

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.number} - {self.customer.name}"

    def calculate_totals(self):
        """محاسبه جمع کل از روی اقلام"""
        items = self.items.all()
        subtotal = sum(item.total_price for item in items)

        self.subtotal = subtotal
        after_discount = subtotal - self.discount
        self.tax_amount = int(after_discount * self.tax_percent / 100)
        self.total = after_discount + self.tax_amount
        return self.total

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        # تولید شماره فاکتور خودکار — با تاریخ شمسی و ضد race condition
        if not self.number:
            with transaction.atomic():
                last = Invoice.objects.select_for_update().order_by('-id').first()
                new_id = (last.id + 1) if last else 1
                now_j = jdatetime.datetime.now()
                self.number = f"INV-{now_j.year}{now_j.month:02d}-{new_id:04d}"

        super().save(*args, **kwargs)

    @property
    def status_color(self):
        return {
            'draft': 'gray',
            'issued': 'blue',
            'paid': 'green',
            'cancelled': 'red',
        }.get(self.status, 'gray')

    @property
    def items_count(self):
        return self.items.count()


class InvoiceItem(models.Model):
    """قلم فاکتور — هر خط از فاکتور"""

    invoice = models.ForeignKey(
        Invoice, on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name='items', verbose_name='فاکتور'
    )
    product = models.ForeignKey(
        Product, on_delete=models.PROTECT,
        related_name='invoice_items', verbose_name='کالا'
    )

    quantity = models.PositiveIntegerField('تعداد', default=1)
    unit_price = models.DecimalField('قیمت واحد', max_digits=15, decimal_places=0, default=0)
    total_price = models.DecimalField('جمع خط', max_digits=15, decimal_places=0, default=0)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = 'قلم فاکتور'
        verbose_name_plural = 'اقلام فاکتور'

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.product.name} × {self.quantity}"

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        # اگه قیمت واحد خالی بود، از قیمت کالا بگیر
        if not self.unit_price:
            self.unit_price = self.product.price

        self.total_price = self.quantity * self.unit_price
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)


class InvoiceLog(models.Model):
    """لاگ تغییرات فاکتور — Audit Trail (۷.۹)"""

    ACTION_CREATED = 'created'
    ACTION_STATUS = 'status'
    ACTION_UPDATED = 'updated'
    ACTION_ITEM_ADDED = 'item_added'
    ACTION_ITEM_CHANGED = 'item_changed'
    ACTION_ITEM_REMOVED = 'item_removed'

    ACTION_CHOICES = [
        (ACTION_CREATED, 'صدور فاکتور'),
        (ACTION_STATUS, 'تغییر وضعیت'),
        (ACTION_UPDATED, 'ویرایش اطلاعات'),
        (ACTION_ITEM_ADDED, 'افزودن قلم'),
        (ACTION_ITEM_CHANGED, 'ویرایش قلم'),
        (ACTION_ITEM_REMOVED, 'حذف قلم'),
    ]

    ACTION_ICONS = {
        ACTION_CREATED: '📄',
        ACTION_STATUS: '🔄',
        ACTION_UPDATED: '✏️',
        ACTION_ITEM_ADDED: '➕',
        ACTION_ITEM_CHANGED: '📝',
        ACTION_ITEM_REMOVED: '➖',
    }

    invoice = models.ForeignKey(
        Invoice, on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name='logs', verbose_name='فاکتور'
    )
    user = models.ForeignKey(
        User, on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True,
        related_name='invoice_logs', verbose_name='کاربر'
    )
    action = models.CharField(
        'رویداد', max_length=20,
        choices=ACTION_CHOICES, db_index=True,
    )
    field_name = models.CharField('نام فیلد', max_length=50, blank=True)
    old_value = models.TextField('مقدار قبلی', blank=True)
    new_value = models.TextField('مقدار جدید', blank=True)
    description = models.TextField('توضیحات')
    created_at = models.DateTimeField('تاریخ ثبت', auto_now_add=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = 'لاگ فاکتور'
        verbose_name_plural = 'لاگ‌های فاکتور'
        ordering = ['-created_at']
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=['invoice', '-created_at']),
        ]

    def __str__(self):
        return f'{self.invoice.number} — {self.get_action_display()}'

    @property
    def user_display(self):
        if not self.user:
            return 'سیستم'
        return self.user.get_full_name() or self.user.username

    @property
    def icon(self):
        return self.ACTION_ICONS.get(self.action, '•')
