from decimal import Decimal
from datetime import date, datetime

from django.db.models.signals import pre_save, post_save, post_delete
from django.dispatch import receiver

from crm.middleware import get_current_user
from .models import Invoice, InvoiceItem, InvoiceLog


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# محاسبه‌ی مجدد مبالغ (موجود)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

def _recalc_invoice_totals(invoice_id):
    """محاسبه‌ی مجدد مبالغ فاکتور — با مقاومت در برابر حذف همزمان"""
    try:
        invoice = Invoice.objects.get(pk=invoice_id)
    except (Invoice.DoesNotExist, TypeError):
        return

    invoice.calculate_totals()
    invoice.save(update_fields=['subtotal', 'tax_amount', 'total', 'updated_at'])


@receiver(post_save, sender=InvoiceItem)
def recalc_on_item_save(sender, instance, **kwargs):
    """بعد از ذخیره‌ی هر قلم، مبالغ فاکتور رو دوباره حساب کن"""
    _recalc_invoice_totals(instance.invoice_id)


@receiver(post_delete, sender=InvoiceItem)
def recalc_on_item_delete(sender, instance, **kwargs):
    """بعد از حذف هر قلم، مبالغ فاکتور رو دوباره حساب کن"""
    _recalc_invoice_totals(instance.invoice_id)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Audit Trail — ۷.۹
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# فیلدهایی که در فاکتور رصد می‌شن
TRACKED_INVOICE_FIELDS = {
    'status': 'وضعیت',
    'payment_type': 'نوع پرداخت',
    'discount': 'تخفیف',
    'tax_percent': 'درصد مالیات',
    'due_date': 'مهلت پرداخت',
    'issue_date': 'تاریخ صدور',
}

# فیلدهایی که saveهای داخلی (recalc) با update_fields می‌فرستن
_INTERNAL_UPDATE_FIELDS = {'subtotal', 'tax_amount', 'total', 'updated_at'}


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# مقایسه‌ی امن مقادیر — type-agnostic
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

def _to_comparable(v):
    """
    تبدیل مقدار به یک شکل قابل مقایسه‌ی یکنواخت:
    - Decimal → normalize (9.00 → 9)
    - datetime → date ISO (چون فقط date-level comparison لازمه)
    - None → رشته‌ی خالی
    """
    if v is None:
        return ''
    if isinstance(v, Decimal):
        return str(v.normalize())
    if isinstance(v, datetime):
        return v.date().isoformat()
    if isinstance(v, date):
        return v.isoformat()
    return str(v)


def _values_equal(a, b):
    """آیا دو مقدار برابرن؟ (با نرمال‌سازی type)"""
    return _to_comparable(a) == _to_comparable(b)


def _format_value(field_name, value, instance):
    """نمایش خوانا از یک مقدار (choice fields رو به display تبدیل می‌کنه)"""
    if value is None or value == '':
        return '—'

    if field_name == 'status' and instance is not None:
        method = getattr(instance, 'get_status_display', None)
        if method:
            return str(method())

    if field_name == 'payment_type' and instance is not None:
        method = getattr(instance, 'get_payment_type_display', None)
        if method:
            return str(method())

    return str(value)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Invoice: pre_save — گرفتن state قدیمی
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@receiver(pre_save, sender=Invoice)
def capture_old_invoice_state(sender, instance, **kwargs):
    update_fields = kwargs.get('update_fields')

    # saveهای داخلی (recalc) رو نادیده بگیر
    if update_fields is not None and set(update_fields).issubset(_INTERNAL_UPDATE_FIELDS):
        instance._old_state = None
        return

    # ایجاد جدید — state قدیمی نداره
    if not instance.pk:
        instance._old_state = None
        return

    try:
        instance._old_state = Invoice.objects.get(pk=instance.pk)
    except Invoice.DoesNotExist:
        instance._old_state = None


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Invoice: post_save — ثبت لاگ
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@receiver(post_save, sender=Invoice)
def log_invoice_save(sender, instance, created, **kwargs):
    update_fields = kwargs.get('update_fields')

    if update_fields is not None and set(update_fields).issubset(_INTERNAL_UPDATE_FIELDS):
        return

    user = get_current_user()

    # ─── ایجاد جدید ───
    if created:
        InvoiceLog.objects.create(
            invoice=instance,
            user=user,
            action=InvoiceLog.ACTION_CREATED,
            description=f'فاکتور «{instance.number}» صادر شد.',
        )
        return

    # ─── ویرایش — مقایسه با state قدیمی ───
    old = getattr(instance, '_old_state', None)
    if not old:
        return

    for field, label in TRACKED_INVOICE_FIELDS.items():
        old_val = getattr(old, field, None)
        new_val = getattr(instance, field, None)

        # ⭐ مقایسه‌ی امن با نرمال‌سازی type
        if _values_equal(old_val, new_val):
            continue

        old_display = _format_value(field, old_val, old)
        new_display = _format_value(field, new_val, instance)

        action = (
            InvoiceLog.ACTION_STATUS if field == 'status'
            else InvoiceLog.ACTION_UPDATED
        )

        InvoiceLog.objects.create(
            invoice=instance,
            user=user,
            action=action,
            field_name=field,
            old_value=_to_comparable(old_val),
            new_value=_to_comparable(new_val),
            description=f'{label}: {old_display} → {new_display}',
        )


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# InvoiceItem: pre_save — state قدیمی
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@receiver(pre_save, sender=InvoiceItem)
def capture_old_item_state(sender, instance, **kwargs):
    if not instance.pk:
        instance._old_state = None
        return
    try:
        instance._old_state = InvoiceItem.objects.get(pk=instance.pk)
    except InvoiceItem.DoesNotExist:
        instance._old_state = None


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# InvoiceItem: post_save — ثبت لاگ
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@receiver(post_save, sender=InvoiceItem)
def log_item_save(sender, instance, created, **kwargs):
    user = get_current_user()

    if created:
        InvoiceLog.objects.create(
            invoice=instance.invoice,
            user=user,
            action=InvoiceLog.ACTION_ITEM_ADDED,
            description=(
                f'کالای «{instance.product.name}» × {instance.quantity} افزوده شد.'
            ),
        )
        return

    old = getattr(instance, '_old_state', None)
    if not old:
        return

    changes = []
    if not _values_equal(old.quantity, instance.quantity):
        changes.append(f'تعداد {old.quantity} → {instance.quantity}')
    if not _values_equal(old.unit_price, instance.unit_price):
        old_price = old.unit_price or 0
        changes.append(
            f'قیمت واحد {old_price:,} → {instance.unit_price:,} تومان'
        )

    if not changes:
        return

    InvoiceLog.objects.create(
        invoice=instance.invoice,
        user=user,
        action=InvoiceLog.ACTION_ITEM_CHANGED,
        description=f'قلم «{instance.product.name}» ویرایش شد — ' + '، '.join(changes),
    )


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# InvoiceItem: post_delete — ثبت لاگ
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@receiver(post_delete, sender=InvoiceItem)
def log_item_delete(sender, instance, **kwargs):
    user = get_current_user()
    InvoiceLog.objects.create(
        invoice=instance.invoice,
        user=user,
        action=InvoiceLog.ACTION_ITEM_REMOVED,
        description=(
            f'کالای «{instance.product.name}» × {instance.quantity} حذف شد.'
        ),
    )

"""

import jdatetime
from django.test import TestCase
from django.contrib.auth.models import User

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# تست شماره فاکتور شمسی
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
class InvoiceNumberTest(TestCase):

    @classmethod
    def setUpTestData(cls):
        cls.customer = Customer.objects.create(
            name='مشتری', mobile='09120000001',
        )

    def test_number_format_jalali(self):
        """شماره فاکتور با سال/ماه شمسی"""
        inv = Invoice.objects.create(customer=self.customer)
        now_j = jdatetime.datetime.now()
        expected_prefix = f"INV-{now_j.year}{now_j.month:02d}-"
        self.assertTrue(
            inv.number.startswith(expected_prefix),
            f'شماره {inv.number} باید با {expected_prefix} شروع شود'
        )

    def test_number_is_unique(self):
        """دو فاکتور پشت‌سرهم شماره‌های متفاوت دارن"""
        inv1 = Invoice.objects.create(customer=self.customer)
        inv2 = Invoice.objects.create(customer=self.customer)
        self.assertNotEqual(inv1.number, inv2.number)

    def test_number_has_4_digit_suffix(self):
        """پسوند ۴ رقمی"""
        inv = Invoice.objects.create(customer=self.customer)
        suffix = inv.number.split('-')[-1]
        self.assertEqual(len(suffix), 4)
        self.assertTrue(suffix.isdigit())

    def test_manual_number_preserved(self):
        """اگر شماره دستی داده بشه، تغییر نمی‌کنه"""
        inv = Invoice.objects.create(
            customer=self.customer,
            number='CUSTOM-001',
        )
        self.assertEqual(inv.number, 'CUSTOM-001')

class InvoiceTotalsSignalTest(TestCase):

    @classmethod
    def setUpTestData(cls):
        cls.user = User.objects.create_user('sales_user', password='t123456')
        cls.customer = Customer.objects.create(
            name='مشتری', mobile='09120000002',
        )
        cls.category = Category.objects.create(
            name='دسته تستی', slug='test-signal-cat',
        )
        cls.p1 = Product.objects.create(
            name='کالای ۱', code='P1', category=cls.category,
            price=100000, stock=100,
        )
        cls.p2 = Product.objects.create(
            name='کالای ۲', code='P2', category=cls.category,
            price=200000, stock=100,
        )

    def _make_invoice(self, tax_percent=9, discount=0):
        inv = Invoice.objects.create(
            customer=self.customer,
            tax_percent=tax_percent,
            discount=discount,
        )
        return inv

    def test_totals_calculated_on_item_create(self):
        """هنگام ایجاد InvoiceItem، مبالغ خودکار محاسبه می‌شن"""
        inv = self._make_invoice()
        InvoiceItem.objects.create(
            invoice=inv, product=self.p1, quantity=2, unit_price=100000,
        )
        inv.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(inv.subtotal, 200000)
        self.assertEqual(inv.tax_amount, 18000)  # ۹٪
        self.assertEqual(inv.total, 218000)

    def test_totals_with_multiple_items(self):
        """چند قلم"""
        inv = self._make_invoice()
        InvoiceItem.objects.create(invoice=inv, product=self.p1, quantity=2, unit_price=100000)
        InvoiceItem.objects.create(invoice=inv, product=self.p2, quantity=1, unit_price=200000)
        inv.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(inv.subtotal, 400000)
        self.assertEqual(inv.tax_amount, 36000)
        self.assertEqual(inv.total, 436000)

    def test_totals_with_discount(self):
        """با تخفیف"""
        inv = self._make_invoice(discount=50000)
        InvoiceItem.objects.create(invoice=inv, product=self.p1, quantity=2, unit_price=100000)
        inv.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(inv.subtotal, 200000)
        self.assertEqual(inv.tax_amount, 13500)
        self.assertEqual(inv.total, 163500)

    def test_totals_recalculated_on_item_update(self):
        """ویرایش قلم → محاسبه‌ی مجدد"""
        inv = self._make_invoice()
        item = InvoiceItem.objects.create(
            invoice=inv, product=self.p1, quantity=2, unit_price=100000,
        )
        inv.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(inv.subtotal, 200000)

        item.quantity = 5
        item.save()
        inv.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(inv.subtotal, 500000)

    def test_totals_recalculated_on_item_delete(self):
        """حذف قلم → محاسبه‌ی مجدد"""
        inv = self._make_invoice()
        InvoiceItem.objects.create(invoice=inv, product=self.p1, quantity=2, unit_price=100000)
        item2 = InvoiceItem.objects.create(invoice=inv, product=self.p2, quantity=1, unit_price=200000)
        inv.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(inv.subtotal, 400000)

        item2.delete()
        inv.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(inv.subtotal, 200000)
        self.assertEqual(inv.total, 218000)

    def test_totals_with_zero_items(self):
        """فاکتور بدون قلم → همه صفر"""
        inv = self._make_invoice()
        inv.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(inv.subtotal, 0)
        self.assertEqual(inv.tax_amount, 0)
        self.assertEqual(inv.total, 0)

    def test_totals_with_zero_tax(self):
        """مالیات صفر"""
        inv = self._make_invoice(tax_percent=0)
        InvoiceItem.objects.create(invoice=inv, product=self.p1, quantity=1, unit_price=100000)
        inv.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(inv.subtotal, 100000)
        self.assertEqual(inv.tax_amount, 0)
        self.assertEqual(inv.total, 100000)

    def test_tax_rounding(self):
        """رند کردن مالیات — int() استفاده می‌شه نه round()"""
        inv = self._make_invoice()
        InvoiceItem.objects.create(invoice=inv, product=self.p1, quantity=1, unit_price=100001)
        inv.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(inv.tax_amount, 9000)

from crm.middleware import _thread_locals


class InvoiceLogTest(TestCase):
    """تست‌های Audit Trail — فاز ۷.۹"""

    @classmethod
    def setUpTestData(cls):
        cls.user = User.objects.create_user('logger', password='t123456')
        cls.customer = Customer.objects.create(name='م', mobile='09120000100')
        cls.category = Category.objects.create(name='د', slug='log-cat')
        cls.product = Product.objects.create(
            name='کالای لاگ', code='LOG-1', category=cls.category,
            price=100000, stock=100,
        )

    def test_created_log(self):
        """ایجاد فاکتور → یک لاگ created"""
        invoice = Invoice.objects.create(customer=self.customer)
        logs = InvoiceLog.objects.filter(invoice=invoice)
        self.assertEqual(logs.count(), 1)
        log = logs.first()
        self.assertEqual(log.action, InvoiceLog.ACTION_CREATED)
        self.assertIn(invoice.number, log.description)

    def test_status_change_log(self):
        """تغییر وضعیت → لاگ status"""
        invoice = Invoice.objects.create(customer=self.customer, status='draft')
        InvoiceLog.objects.all().delete()

        invoice.status = 'issued'
        invoice.save()

        log = InvoiceLog.objects.filter(
            invoice=invoice, action=InvoiceLog.ACTION_STATUS
        ).first()
        self.assertIsNotNone(log)
        self.assertEqual(log.field_name, 'status')
        self.assertIn('پیش‌نویس', log.description)
        self.assertIn('صادر شده', log.description)

    def test_discount_change_log(self):
        """تغییر تخفیف → لاگ updated"""
        invoice = Invoice.objects.create(customer=self.customer)
        InvoiceLog.objects.all().delete()

        invoice.discount = 50000
        invoice.save()

        log = InvoiceLog.objects.filter(
            invoice=invoice, field_name='discount'
        ).first()
        self.assertIsNotNone(log)
        self.assertEqual(log.action, InvoiceLog.ACTION_UPDATED)

    def test_payment_type_change_log(self):
        """تغییر نوع پرداخت → لاگ با display"""
        invoice = Invoice.objects.create(customer=self.customer, payment_type='cash')
        InvoiceLog.objects.all().delete()

        invoice.payment_type = 'cheque'
        invoice.save()

        log = InvoiceLog.objects.filter(
            invoice=invoice, field_name='payment_type'
        ).first()
        self.assertIsNotNone(log)
        self.assertIn('نقدی', log.description)
        self.assertIn('چکی', log.description)

    def test_item_added_log(self):
        """افزودن قلم → لاگ item_added"""
        invoice = Invoice.objects.create(customer=self.customer)
        InvoiceLog.objects.all().delete()

        InvoiceItem.objects.create(
            invoice=invoice, product=self.product,
            quantity=3, unit_price=100000,
        )

        log = InvoiceLog.objects.filter(
            invoice=invoice, action=InvoiceLog.ACTION_ITEM_ADDED
        ).first()
        self.assertIsNotNone(log)
        self.assertIn('کالای لاگ', log.description)
        self.assertIn('3', log.description)

    def test_item_changed_log(self):
        """ویرایش قلم → لاگ item_changed"""
        invoice = Invoice.objects.create(customer=self.customer)
        item = InvoiceItem.objects.create(
            invoice=invoice, product=self.product,
            quantity=2, unit_price=100000,
        )
        InvoiceLog.objects.all().delete()

        item.quantity = 5
        item.save()

        log = InvoiceLog.objects.filter(
            invoice=invoice, action=InvoiceLog.ACTION_ITEM_CHANGED
        ).first()
        self.assertIsNotNone(log)
        self.assertIn('2', log.description)
        self.assertIn('5', log.description)

    def test_item_removed_log(self):
        """حذف قلم → لاگ item_removed"""
        invoice = Invoice.objects.create(customer=self.customer)
        item = InvoiceItem.objects.create(
            invoice=invoice, product=self.product,
            quantity=3, unit_price=100000,
        )
        InvoiceLog.objects.all().delete()

        item.delete()

        log = InvoiceLog.objects.filter(
            invoice=invoice, action=InvoiceLog.ACTION_ITEM_REMOVED
        ).first()
        self.assertIsNotNone(log)
        self.assertIn('حذف', log.description)

    def test_internal_recalc_no_log(self):
        """save داخلی (update_fields=internal) لاگ نمی‌سازه"""
        invoice = Invoice.objects.create(customer=self.customer)
        InvoiceItem.objects.create(
            invoice=invoice, product=self.product,
            quantity=1, unit_price=100000,
        )
        InvoiceLog.objects.all().delete()

        invoice.save(update_fields=['subtotal', 'tax_amount', 'total', 'updated_at'])

        self.assertEqual(InvoiceLog.objects.count(), 0)

    def test_no_log_when_no_changes(self):
        """save بدون تغییر → لاگ نمی‌سازه"""
        invoice = Invoice.objects.create(customer=self.customer, status='draft')
        InvoiceLog.objects.all().delete()

        invoice.save()

        self.assertEqual(InvoiceLog.objects.filter(invoice=invoice).count(), 0)

    def test_user_captured_via_thread_local(self):
        """کاربر از thread-local گرفته می‌شه"""
        _thread_locals.user = self.user
        try:
            invoice = Invoice.objects.create(customer=self.customer)
            log = InvoiceLog.objects.filter(invoice=invoice).first()
            self.assertEqual(log.user, self.user)
        finally:
            _thread_locals.user = None

    def test_no_user_when_outside_request(self):
        """خارج از request، user=None"""
        invoice = Invoice.objects.create(customer=self.customer)
        log = InvoiceLog.objects.filter(invoice=invoice).first()
        self.assertIsNone(log.user)

    def test_user_display_fallback(self):
        """user_display وقتی None باشه → 'سیستم'"""
        invoice = Invoice.objects.create(customer=self.customer)
        log = InvoiceLog.objects.filter(invoice=invoice).first()
        self.assertEqual(log.user_display, 'سیستم')

import json
import jdatetime
from django.shortcuts import render, get_object_or_404, redirect
from django.contrib.auth.decorators import login_required
from django.contrib import messages
from django.core.paginator import Paginator
from django.db import transaction
from django.db.models import Q, Sum
from django.utils import timezone
from django.contrib.auth.models import User
from products.models import Product
from accounts.permissions import require_permission
from .models import Invoice, InvoiceItem
from .forms import InvoiceForm, InvoiceItemFormSet


# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ثابت‌های مدیریت موجودی
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════
DEDUCTING_STATUSES = ('issued', 'paid')


# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════
# توابع کمکی
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════

def _parse_jalali_date(value):
    """تبدیل تاریخ شمسی به میلادی (۷.۶)"""
    if not value:
        return None
    try:
        persian = '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'
        arabic = '٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩'
        for i, (p, a) in enumerate(zip(persian, arabic)):
            value = value.replace(p, str(i)).replace(a, str(i))
        value = value.replace('-', '/').replace('.', '/')
        if ' ' in value:
            value = value.split(' ', 1)[0]
        y, m, d = map(int, value.split('/'))
        return jdatetime.date(y, m, d).togregorian()
    except (ValueError, AttributeError):
        return None


def _get_employee_choices():
    """کاربران فعال برای dropdown فیلتر"""
    return User.objects.filter(
        is_active=True,
        is_staff=True,
    ).order_by('first_name', 'last_name', 'username')


def _products_data():
    """
    لیست کالاهای فعال با نام + کد + قیمت — برای autocomplete (۷.۱۰).
    سبک و cache-friendly.
    """
    return [
        {
            'id': p.pk,
            'name': p.name,
            'code': p.code,
            'price': float(p.price),
        }
        for p in Product.objects.only('id', 'name', 'code', 'price')
    ]


def _apply_invoice_stock(invoice, user):
    """
    کاهش موجودی برای همه‌ی اقلام فاکتور.
    اگر موجودی هر کالایی کافی نباشد ValueError می‌دهد.
    باید داخل یک transaction.atomic صدا زده شود.
    """
    for item in invoice.items.select_related('product'):
        item.product.change_stock(
            -item.quantity,
            movement_type='out',
            user=user,
            reference_type='invoice',
            reference_id=invoice.pk,
            reference_note=invoice.number,
        )


def _reverse_invoice_stock(invoice, user):
    """
    برگرداندن موجودی همه‌ی اقلام فاکتور.
    برای لغو، ویرایش یا حذف فاکتور استفاده می‌شود.
    """
    for item in invoice.items.select_related('product'):
        item.product.change_stock(
            +item.quantity,
            movement_type='cancel',
            user=user,
            reference_type='invoice',
            reference_id=invoice.pk,
            reference_note=f'برگشت {invoice.number}',
        )


# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════
# فیلترهای پیشرفته (۷.۶)
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════

def _apply_invoice_filters(qs, request):
    """اعمال همه‌ی فیلترها روی queryset فاکتورها — برمی‌گردونه (qs, filters_dict)"""
    search = request.GET.get('q', '').strip()
    if search:
        qs = qs.filter(
            Q(number__icontains=search) |
            Q(customer__name__icontains=search) |
            Q(customer__mobile__icontains=search)
        )

    status = request.GET.get('status', '').strip()
    if status:
        qs = qs.filter(status=status)

    payment_type = request.GET.get('payment_type', '').strip()
    if payment_type:
        qs = qs.filter(payment_type=payment_type)

    employee = request.GET.get('employee', '').strip()
    if employee:
        qs = qs.filter(created_by_id=employee)

    from_date_str = request.GET.get('from_date', '').strip()
    to_date_str = request.GET.get('to_date', '').strip()
    from_date = _parse_jalali_date(from_date_str)
    to_date = _parse_jalali_date(to_date_str)
    if from_date:
        qs = qs.filter(issue_date__gte=from_date)
    if to_date:
        qs = qs.filter(issue_date__lte=to_date)

    amount_min_str = request.GET.get('amount_min', '').strip()
    amount_max_str = request.GET.get('amount_max', '').strip()
    try:
        if amount_min_str:
            qs = qs.filter(total__gte=int(amount_min_str.replace(',', '')))
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        amount_min_str = ''
    try:
        if amount_max_str:
            qs = qs.filter(total__lte=int(amount_max_str.replace(',', '')))
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        amount_max_str = ''

    filters = {
        'search': search,
        'current_status': status,
        'current_payment': payment_type,
        'current_employee': employee,
        'from_date': from_date_str,
        'to_date': to_date_str,
        'amount_min': amount_min_str,
        'amount_max': amount_max_str,
    }
    return qs, filters


# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════
# فهرست و جزئیات
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════
@login_required
@require_permission('invoices.view')
def invoice_list(request):
    qs = Invoice.objects.select_related('customer', 'created_by').all()
    qs, filters = _apply_invoice_filters(qs, request)

    all_invoices = Invoice.objects.all()
    stats = {
        'total': all_invoices.count(),
        'draft': all_invoices.filter(status='draft').count(),
        'issued': all_invoices.filter(status='issued').count(),
        'paid': all_invoices.filter(status='paid').count(),
        'total_amount': all_invoices.filter(
            status__in=DEDUCTING_STATUSES
        ).aggregate(s=Sum('total'))['s'] or 0,
    }

    has_filters = any([
        filters['search'], filters['current_status'],
        filters['current_payment'], filters['current_employee'],
        filters['from_date'], filters['to_date'],
        filters['amount_min'], filters['amount_max'],
    ])

    filtered_stats = None
    if has_filters:
        filtered_stats = {
            'count': qs.count(),
            'total': qs.aggregate(s=Sum('total'))['s'] or 0,
        }

    paginator = Paginator(qs, 20)
    page_obj = paginator.get_page(request.GET.get('page', 1))

    context = {
        'page_obj': page_obj,
        'stats': stats,
        'filtered_stats': filtered_stats,
        'has_filters': has_filters,
        'employees': _get_employee_choices(),
        'status_choices': Invoice.STATUS_CHOICES,
        'payment_choices': Invoice.PAYMENT_TYPE_CHOICES,
        **filters,
    }
    return render(request, 'sales/list.html', context)


@login_required
@require_permission('invoices.view')
def invoice_detail(request, pk):
    invoice = get_object_or_404(
        Invoice.objects
        .select_related('customer', 'created_by')
        .prefetch_related('logs__user'),
        pk=pk,
    )
    items = invoice.items.select_related('product')
    return render(request, 'sales/detail.html', {
        'invoice': invoice,
        'items': items,
    })

# ایجاد فاکتور
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════
@login_required
@require_permission('invoices.add')
def invoice_create(request):
    initial = {}
    customer_id = request.GET.get('customer')
    if customer_id:
        initial['customer'] = customer_id

    if request.method == 'POST':
        form = InvoiceForm(request.POST)
        formset = InvoiceItemFormSet(request.POST)

        if form.is_valid() and formset.is_valid():
            try:
                with transaction.atomic():
                    invoice = form.save(commit=False)
                    invoice.created_by = request.user
                    invoice.save()

                    formset.instance = invoice
                    formset.save()

                    if invoice.status in DEDUCTING_STATUSES:
                        _apply_invoice_stock(invoice, request.user)

                messages.success(request, f'فاکتور «{invoice.number}» با موفقیت ثبت شد.')
                return redirect('sales:detail', pk=invoice.pk)
            except ValueError as e:
                messages.error(request, f'خطا در موجودی: {e}')
    else:
        form = InvoiceForm(initial=initial)
        formset = InvoiceItemFormSet()

    return render(request, 'sales/form.html', {
        'form': form,
        'formset': formset,
        'title': 'صدور فاکتور جدید',
        'submit_label': 'صدور فاکتور',
        'products_data': _products_data(),
    })


# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ویرایش فاکتور
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════
@login_required
@require_permission('invoices.edit')
def invoice_edit(request, pk):
    invoice = get_object_or_404(Invoice, pk=pk)

    if request.method == 'POST':
        old_status = invoice.status
        form = InvoiceForm(request.POST, instance=invoice)
        formset = InvoiceItemFormSet(request.POST, instance=invoice)

        if form.is_valid() and formset.is_valid():
            try:
                with transaction.atomic():
                    if old_status in DEDUCTING_STATUSES:
                        _reverse_invoice_stock(invoice, request.user)

                    invoice = form.save()
                    formset.save()

                    if invoice.status in DEDUCTING_STATUSES:
                        _apply_invoice_stock(invoice, request.user)

                messages.success(request, 'فاکتور به‌روزرسانی شد.')
                return redirect('sales:detail', pk=invoice.pk)
            except ValueError as e:
                messages.error(request, f'خطا در موجودی: {e}')
    else:
        form = InvoiceForm(instance=invoice)
        formset = InvoiceItemFormSet(instance=invoice)

    return render(request, 'sales/form.html', {
        'form': form,
        'formset': formset,
        'title': f'ویرایش فاکتور {invoice.number}',
        'submit_label': 'ذخیره تغییرات',
        'invoice': invoice,
        'products_data': _products_data(),
    })


# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════
# حذف فاکتور
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════
@login_required
@require_permission('invoices.delete')
def invoice_delete(request, pk):
    invoice = get_object_or_404(Invoice, pk=pk)

    if request.method == 'POST':
        try:
            with transaction.atomic():
                if invoice.status in DEDUCTING_STATUSES:
                    _reverse_invoice_stock(invoice, request.user)

                number = invoice.number
                invoice.delete()

            messages.success(request, f'فاکتور «{number}» حذف شد و موجودی برگشت.')
            return redirect('sales:list')
        except Exception as e:
            messages.error(request, f'خطا در حذف فاکتور: {e}')
            return redirect('sales:detail', pk=pk)

    return render(request, 'sales/confirm_delete.html', {'invoice': invoice})

# چاپ فاکتور
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════
@login_required
@require_permission('invoices.print')
def invoice_print(request, pk):
    """نسخه چاپی فاکتور"""
    from django.conf import settings

    invoice = get_object_or_404(
        Invoice.objects.select_related('customer', 'created_by'),
        pk=pk
    )
    items = invoice.items.select_related('product')

    context = {
        'invoice': invoice,
        'items': items,
        'company': settings.COMPANY_INFO,
        'print_date': timezone.now(),
    }
    return render(request, 'sales/print.html', context)

  var createElement = function createElement(tag, parent, eventNames, event, content, contentMode) {
    if (contentMode === void 0) {
      contentMode = "text";
    }
    var splits = tag.split(".");
    tag = splits.shift() || "div";
    var className = splits;
    var element = window.document.createElement(tag);
    if (isString(parent)) {
      var parentElement = window.document.querySelector(parent);
      if (!parentElement) {
        throw new Error("Parent element not found: " + parent);
      }
      parentElement.appendChild(element);
    } else {
      parent.appendChild(element);
    }
    if (className.length) {
      element.className = className.join(" ");
    }
    if (eventNames && event) {
      addListenerMulti(element, eventNames, event);
    }
    if (!isUndefined(content)) {
      if (contentMode === "html") {
        setInnerHTML(element, content);
      } else {
        element.textContent = content;
      }
    }
    return element;

  function addEventListenerOnBody() {
    document.body.removeEventListener("click", onBodyClickCallback);
    document.body.addEventListener("click", onBodyClickCallback);
  }
  function handleEscKey(event) {
    if (event.key === "Escape") {
      if (!jalaliDatepicker.isTransitioning) {
        var _jalaliDatepicker$inp;
        (_jalaliDatepicker$inp = jalaliDatepicker.input) == null || _jalaliDatepicker$inp.blur == null || _jalaliDatepicker$inp.blur();
        jalaliDatepicker.hide();
      }
    }
  }
  window.jalaliDatepicker = {
    startWatch: function startWatch(options) {
      if (options === void 0) {
        options = {};
      }
      jalaliDatepicker.init(options);
    },
    show: function show(input) {
      jalaliDatepicker.show(input);
    },
    hide: function hide() {
      jalaliDatepicker.hide();
    },
    updateOptions: function updateOptions(options) {
      jalaliDatepicker.updateOptions(options);
    }
  };
})();

{# JS: به‌روزرسانی زنده‌ی وضعیت نقش #}
{# ═══════════════════════════════════════ #}
{% if permissions_map %}{{ permissions_map|json_script:"permissions-data" }}{% endif %}
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const dataEl = document.getElementById('permissions-data');
    const roleSelect = document.querySelector('select[name="role"]');
    if (!dataEl || !roleSelect) return;

    const permissions = JSON.parse(dataEl.textContent);

    const checkIcon = '<span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-green-600">'
        + '<svg class="w-3.5 h-3.5" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20">'
        + '<path fill-rule="evenodd" d="M10 18a8 8 0 100-16 8 8 0 000 16zm3.707-9.293a1 1 0 00-1.414-1.414L9 10.586 7.707 9.293a1 1 0 00-1.414 1.414l2 2a1 1 0 001.414 0l4-4z" clip-rule="evenodd"/>'
        + '</svg>دارد</span>';

    const crossIcon = '<span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-gray-400">'
        + '<svg class="w-3.5 h-3.5" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20">'
        + '<path fill-rule="evenodd" d="M10 18a8 8 0 100-16 8 8 0 000 16zM8.707 7.293a1 1 0 00-1.414 1.414L8.586 10l-1.293 1.293a1 1 0 101.414 1.414L10 11.414l1.293 1.293a1 1 0 001.414-1.414L11.414 10l1.293-1.293a1 1 0 00-1.414-1.414L10 8.586 8.707 7.293z" clip-rule="evenodd"/>'
        + '</svg>ندارد</span>';

    function updateRoleStatus() {
        const role = roleSelect.value;
        document.querySelectorAll('tr[data-perm-key]').forEach(function(row) {
            const key = row.dataset.permKey;
            const roles = permissions[key] || [];
            const has = (role === 'admin') || roles.includes(role);
            const cell = row.querySelector('[data-role-status-cell]');
            if (cell) {
                cell.innerHTML = has ? checkIcon : crossIcon;
            }
        });
    }

    roleSelect.addEventListener('change', updateRoleStatus);
});
</script>

{% endblock %}

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  const platformSelect = document.querySelector('select[name="platform"]');
  const processSelect = document.querySelector('select[name="process"]');
  const costInput = document.querySelector('input[name="cost"]');
  const adNumberInput = document.querySelector('input[name="ad_number"]');
  const isEdit = {{ is_edit|yesno:"true,false" }};

  if (!platformSelect || !processSelect) return;

  // 🔄 فیلتر پویای فرآیندها + شماره آگهی بعدی
  platformSelect.addEventListener('change', function() {
    const pid = this.value;
    processSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">---------</option>';

    if (!pid) {
      if (adNumberInput && !isEdit) adNumberInput.value = '';
      return;
    }

    // ۱. فرآیندها
    fetch(`/ads/api/platform/${pid}/processes/`)
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(data => {
        data.processes.forEach(p => {
          const opt = document.createElement('option');
          opt.value = p.id;
          opt.textContent = p.name;
          opt.dataset.cost = p.default_cost;
          processSelect.appendChild(opt);
        });
      })
      .catch(err => console.error('خطا در بارگذاری فرآیندها:', err));

    // ۲. شماره آگهی بعدی (فقط توی create)
    if (adNumberInput && !isEdit) {
      fetch(`/ads/api/platform/${pid}/next-ad-number/`)
        .then(r => r.json())
        .then(data => {
          adNumberInput.value = data.ad_number;
        })
        .catch(err => console.error('خطا در گرفتن شماره آگهی:', err));
    }
  });

  // 💰 پر کردن هزینه با انتخاب فرآیند
  processSelect.addEventListener('change', function() {
    const opt = this.options[this.selectedIndex];
    if (opt && opt.dataset.cost && costInput && !costInput.value) {
      costInput.value = opt.dataset.cost;
    }
  });
});
</script>
{% endblock %}

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {

    // ═══ نمودار فعالیت روزانه ═══
    const dailyLabels = {{ daily_labels_json|safe }};
    const dailyData = {{ daily_data_json|safe }};

    new ApexCharts(document.querySelector("#dailyActivityChart"), {
        chart: {
            type: 'area',
            height: 260,
            fontFamily: 'Vazirmatn',
            toolbar: { show: false },
        },
        series: [{ name: 'رویدادها', data: dailyData }],
        xaxis: {
            categories: dailyLabels,
            labels: { style: { fontFamily: 'Vazirmatn', fontSize: '11px' } },
        },
        yaxis: {
            labels: {
                style: { fontFamily: 'Vazirmatn' },
                formatter: (val) => Math.floor(val),
            },
        },
        colors: ['#3b82f6'],
        stroke: { curve: 'smooth', width: 3 },
        fill: { type: 'gradient', gradient: { opacityFrom: 0.5, opacityTo: 0.1 } },
        dataLabels: { enabled: false },
        grid: { borderColor: '#e5e7eb', strokeDashArray: 3 },
        tooltip: {
            y: { formatter: (val) => val + ' رویداد' },
        },
    }).render();

    // ═══ توزیع رویدادها ═══
    const actionLabels = {{ action_labels_json|safe }};
    const actionData = {{ action_data_json|safe }};

    new ApexCharts(document.querySelector("#actionDistChart"), {
        chart: {
            type: 'donut',
            height: 240,
            fontFamily: 'Vazirmatn',
        },
        series: actionData,
        labels: actionLabels,
        colors: ['#22c55e', '#3b82f6', '#ef4444'],
        legend: {
            position: 'bottom',
            fontFamily: 'Vazirmatn',
            fontSize: '12px',
        },
        dataLabels: {
            enabled: true,
            style: { fontFamily: 'Vazirmatn', fontSize: '12px' },
            formatter: (val) => Math.round(val) + '٪',
        },
        plotOptions: {
            pie: {
                donut: {
                    size: '60%',
                    labels: {
                        show: true,
                        total: {
                            show: true,
                            label: 'کل',
                            fontFamily: 'Vazirmatn',
                            fontSize: '12px',
                            formatter: () => actionData.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0),
                        },
                    },
                },
            },
        },
        tooltip: {
            y: { formatter: (val) => val + ' رویداد' },
        },
    }).render();

});
</script>

"""
دستور مدیریتی برای حذف لاگ‌های قدیمی — فاز بهبود Audit

استفاده:
    python manage.py cleanup_audit                  # ۹۰ روز اخیر
    python manage.py cleanup_audit --days=30        # ۳۰ روز
    python manage.py cleanup_audit --dry-run        # فقط نمایش
"""
from datetime import timedelta

from django.core.management.base import BaseCommand
from django.utils import timezone

from audit.models import AuditLog


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = 'حذف لاگ‌های قدیمی‌تر از N روز (پیش‌فرض: ۹۰)'

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument(
            '--days',
            type=int,
            default=90,
            help='حذف لاگ‌های قدیمی‌تر از N روز (پیش‌فرض: 90)',
        )
        parser.add_argument(
            '--dry-run',
            action='store_true',
            help='فقط نمایش تعداد — بدون حذف',
        )
        parser.add_argument(
            '--keep-created',
            action='store_true',
            help='نگه‌داری لاگ‌های created (فقط updated/deleted حذف بشن)',
        )

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        days = options['days']
        dry_run = options['dry_run']
        keep_created = options['keep_created']

        cutoff = timezone.now() - timedelta(days=days)
        qs = AuditLog.objects.filter(created_at__lt=cutoff)

        if keep_created:
            qs = qs.exclude(action=AuditLog.ACTION_CREATED)

        count = qs.count()
        oldest = qs.order_by('created_at').first()

        if count == 0:
            self.stdout.write(self.style.WARNING(
                f'هیچ لاگی قدیمی‌تر از {days} روز یافت نشد.'
            ))
            return

        # ─── خلاصه ───
        self.stdout.write(f'\n📊 خلاصه:')
        self.stdout.write(f'   تاریخ مرجع: قبل از {cutoff.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")}')
        self.stdout.write(f'   تعداد رکورد: {count}')
        if oldest:
            self.stdout.write(f'   قدیمی‌ترین: {oldest.created_at.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")}')
        if keep_created:
            self.stdout.write(f'   حالت: نگه‌داری created — فقط updated/deleted حذف می‌شن')

        # ─── حذف ───
        if dry_run:
            self.stdout.write(self.style.WARNING(
                f'\n🔍 حالت dry-run — هیچ تغییری اعمال نشد.'
            ))
            return

        confirm = input(f'\n⚠️  {count} رکورد حذف خواهد شد. ادامه می‌دهید؟ [y/N]: ')
        if confirm.lower() != 'y':
            self.stdout.write(self.style.NOTICE('لغو شد.'))
            return

        deleted, _ = qs.delete()
        self.stdout.write(self.style.SUCCESS(
            f'\n✅ {deleted} رکورد حذف شد.'
        ))

<!-- راه‌اندازی Tom Select و اتصال به API ها -->
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/tom-select@2.2.2/dist/js/tom-select.complete.min.js"></script>
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const selects = document.querySelectorAll('select:not(.no-search)');
    let platformTomSelect = null;
    let processTomSelect = null;

    selects.forEach(function(el) {
        let labelText = "انتخاب کنید...";
        
        // پیدا کردن لیبل
        if (el.id) {
            const label = document.querySelector('label[for="' + el.id + '"]');
            if (label) labelText = label.innerText.replace(/[\*\:]/g, '').trim();
        }
        if (labelText === "انتخاب کنید..." && el.closest('div')) {
            const parentLabel = el.closest('div').querySelector('label');
            if (parentLabel) labelText = parentLabel.innerText.replace(/[\*\:]/g, '').trim();
        }
        if (labelText === "انتخاب کنید..." && el.name) {
            const nameMap = {
                'customer': 'مشتری', 'status': 'وضعیت', 'user': 'کارمند', 
                'platform': 'عنوان', 'process': 'فرآیند', 'source': 'منبع', 
                'product': 'محصول', 'employee': 'پرسنل'
            };
            if (nameMap[el.name]) labelText = nameMap[el.name];
        }

        // تغییر متن گزینه پیش‌فرض
        if (el.options.length > 0 && (el.options[0].value === "" || el.options[0].text.includes('---------'))) {
            el.options[0].text = labelText === "انتخاب کنید..." ? "همه موارد" : "همه " + labelText;
        }

        // فعال‌سازی Tom Select
        const ts = new TomSelect(el, {
            create: false,
            plugins: ['dropdown_input'], 
            placeholder: labelText, 
            maxOptions: 1000,
            dropdownParent: 'body', // 👈 این خط مشکل بریده شدن در جدول را حل می‌کند
            render: {
                no_results: function(data, escape) {
                    return '<div class="no-results p-3 text-gray-500 text-center text-sm">موردی یافت نشد</div>';
                }
            }
        });

        // ذخیره نمونه‌ها
        if (el.name === 'platform') platformTomSelect = ts;
        if (el.name === 'process') processTomSelect = ts;
    });

    // ==========================================
    // ۱. وقتی پلتفرم عوض شد، فرآیندها را بیار
    // ==========================================
    if (platformTomSelect && processTomSelect) {
        platformTomSelect.on('change', function(platformId) {
            processTomSelect.clear();
            processTomSelect.clearOptions();
            
            const costInput = document.querySelector('input[name="cost"]');
            if (costInput) costInput.value = '';
            
            if (!platformId) return;

            fetch(`/ads/api/platform/${platformId}/processes/`)
                .then(response => response.json())
                .then(data => {
                    data.processes.forEach(process => {
                        processTomSelect.addOption({
                            value: process.id,
                            text: process.name
                        });
                    });
                    processTomSelect.refreshOptions();
                })
                .catch(err => console.error('Error fetching processes:', err));
        });
    }

    // ==========================================
    // ۲. وقتی فرآیند عوض شد، قیمت را خودکار پر کن
    // ==========================================
    if (processTomSelect) {
        processTomSelect.on('change', function(processId) {
            const costInput = document.querySelector('input[name="cost"]');
            if (!costInput) return;

            if (!processId) {
                costInput.value = ''; 
                return;
            }

            fetch(`/ads/api/process/${processId}/cost/`)
                .then(response => response.json())
                .then(data => {
                    costInput.value = data.cost; 
                })
                .catch(err => console.error('Error fetching cost:', err));
        });
    }
});
</script>

</body>
</html>

<!-- ═══ اسکریپت هماهنگی وضعیت و پیگیری ═══ -->
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    const statusField = document.getElementById('id_status_field');
    const followupCheckbox = document.getElementById('id_followup_checkbox');
    const followupLabel = document.getElementById('followup-label');

    if (!statusField || !followupCheckbox) return;

    // ⭐ هماهنگ‌سازی وضعیت checkbox بر اساس مقدار status
    function syncCheckboxState() {
        if (statusField.value === 'followup') {
            // وضعیت «نیاز به پیگیری» → چک‌باکس غیرفعال
            followupCheckbox.checked = false;
            followupCheckbox.disabled = true;
            if (followupLabel) {
                followupLabel.style.opacity = '0.4';
                followupLabel.style.cursor = 'not-allowed';
                followupLabel.title = 'وقتی وضعیت «نیاز به پیگیری» است، این گزینه غیرفعال می‌شود';
            }
        } else {
            // بقیه وضعیت‌ها → چک‌باکس فعال
            followupCheckbox.disabled = false;
            if (followupLabel) {
                followupLabel.style.opacity = '1';
                followupLabel.style.cursor = 'pointer';
                followupLabel.title = '';
            }
        }
    }

    // وقتی وضعیت عوض می‌شه
    statusField.addEventListener('change', syncCheckboxState);

    // وقتی کاربر تیک «پیگیری انجام شده» رو می‌زنه
    followupCheckbox.addEventListener('change', function () {
        if (this.checked && statusField.value === 'followup') {
            // خودکار وضعیت رو به «پاسخ داده شد» تغییر بده
            statusField.value = 'answered';
            syncCheckboxState();
        }
    });

    // اجرای اولیه
    syncCheckboxState();
});
</script>

{% endblock %}

<script>
    function openReassign(callId, callerName) {
        document.getElementById('reassign-call-id').value = callId;
        document.getElementById('reassign-caller-name').textContent = callerName;
        document.getElementById('reassign-select').value = '';

        const msgEl = document.getElementById('reassign-message');
        if (msgEl) msgEl.classList.add('hidden');

        const modal = document.getElementById('reassign-modal');
        modal.style.display = 'flex';
        modal.classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    function closeReassignModal() {
        const modal = document.getElementById('reassign-modal');
        if (!modal) return;
        modal.style.display = 'none';
        modal.classList.add('hidden');
    }

    async function submitReassign(event) {
        event.preventDefault();

        const callId = document.getElementById('reassign-call-id').value;
        const newUserId = document.getElementById('reassign-select').value;
        const messageEl = document.getElementById('reassign-message');
        const submitBtn = document.getElementById('reassign-submit-btn');

        if (!newUserId) {
            messageEl.className = 'mb-4 text-sm p-3 rounded-lg bg-red-50 text-red-700';
            messageEl.textContent = 'لطفاً یک کارمند انتخاب کنید';
            messageEl.classList.remove('hidden');
            return;
        }

        submitBtn.disabled = true;
        submitBtn.innerHTML = 'در حال ارجاع...';

        try {
            const csrfToken = document.querySelector('[name=csrfmiddlewaretoken]').value;

            const response = await fetch(`/calls/${callId}/reassign/`, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    'X-CSRFToken': csrfToken,
                    'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
                    'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
                },
                body: `called_by=${encodeURIComponent(newUserId)}`
            });

            const data = await response.json();

            if (data.success) {
                messageEl.className = 'mb-4 text-sm p-3 rounded-lg bg-green-50 text-green-700';
                messageEl.textContent = '✅ ' + data.message;
                messageEl.classList.remove('hidden');

                setTimeout(() => {
                    window.location.reload();
                }, 1000);
            } else {
                messageEl.className = 'mb-4 text-sm p-3 rounded-lg bg-red-50 text-red-700';
                messageEl.textContent = '❌ ' + (data.error || 'خطا در ارجاع');
                messageEl.classList.remove('hidden');
                submitBtn.disabled = false;
                submitBtn.innerHTML = 'تلاش مجدد';
            }
        } catch (error) {
            messageEl.className = 'mb-4 text-sm p-3 rounded-lg bg-red-50 text-red-700';
            messageEl.textContent = '❌ خطای شبکه: ' + error.message;
            messageEl.classList.remove('hidden');
            submitBtn.disabled = false;
            submitBtn.innerHTML = 'تلاش مجدد';
        }
    }

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Escape') closeReassignModal();
    });

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        const modal = document.getElementById('reassign-modal');
        if (modal) {
            modal.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                if (e.target === this) closeReassignModal();
            });
        }
    });
</script>
{% endif %}

{% endblock %}

<!-- JS یادداشت‌ها -->
<script>
const CSRF_TOKEN = '{{ csrf_token }}';
const CUSTOMER_ID = {{ customer.pk }};

async function submitNote(event, customerId) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const textEl = document.getElementById('note-text');
    const pinnedEl = document.getElementById('note-pinned');
    const msgEl = document.getElementById('note-message');
    const btn = document.getElementById('note-submit-btn');

    if (!textEl.value.trim()) return;

    btn.disabled = true;
    btn.textContent = 'در حال ثبت...';

    try {
        const params = new URLSearchParams();
        params.append('text', textEl.value);
        if (pinnedEl.checked) params.append('is_pinned', 'on');

        const response = await fetch(`/customers/${customerId}/notes/add/`, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'X-CSRFToken': CSRF_TOKEN,
                'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
                'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
            },
            body: params.toString()
        });

        const data = await response.json();
        if (data.success) {
            window.location.reload();
        } else {
            msgEl.className = 'mt-2 text-sm p-2 rounded-lg bg-red-50 text-red-700';
            msgEl.textContent = data.error || 'خطا در ثبت';
            btn.disabled = false;
            btn.textContent = 'ثبت یادداشت';
        }
    } catch (error) {
        msgEl.className = 'mt-2 text-sm p-2 rounded-lg bg-red-50 text-red-700';
        msgEl.textContent = 'خطای شبکه: ' + error.message;
        btn.disabled = false;
        btn.textContent = 'ثبت یادداشت';
    }
}

async function togglePin(noteId) {
    try {
        const response = await fetch(`/customers/${CUSTOMER_ID}/notes/${noteId}/pin/`, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'X-CSRFToken': CSRF_TOKEN,
                'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
            }
        });
        const data = await response.json();
        if (data.success) window.location.reload();
    } catch (error) {
        alert('خطا: ' + error.message);
    }
}

async function deleteNote(noteId) {
    if (!confirm('این یادداشت حذف شود؟')) return;
    try {
        const response = await fetch(`/customers/${CUSTOMER_ID}/notes/${noteId}/delete/`, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'X-CSRFToken': CSRF_TOKEN,
                'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
            }
        });
        const data = await response.json();
        if (data.success) window.location.reload();
    } catch (error) {
        alert('خطا: ' + error.message);
    }
}
</script>

{% endblock %}

<script>
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════
// توابع کمکی اعداد فارسی
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════
function toFaNum(val) {
    if (val === null || val === undefined) return '۰';
    return val.toString()
        .replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ',')
        .replace(/\d/g, d => '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'[d]);
}

function toFaSimple(val) {
    if (val === null || val === undefined) return '۰';
    return val.toString().replace(/\d/g, d => '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'[d]);
}

// ═══ خواندن داده‌های JSON امن ═══
const compareData = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('compare-data').textContent);
const funnelData = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('funnel-data').textContent);

// ═══ تنظیمات مشترک محور Y ═══
var yaxisMillion = {
    title: {
        text: 'میلیون تومان',
        style: { fontFamily: 'Vazirmatn', fontSize: '12px', color: '#666' }
    },
    labels: {
        formatter: function (val) {
            if (val === 0) return '۰';
            return toFaNum((val / 1000000).toFixed(0));
        },
        style: { fontFamily: 'Vazirmatn' }
    }
};


// ═══ روند فروش ۱۲ ماه ═══
new ApexCharts(document.querySelector("#salesChart"), {
    chart: { type: 'area', height: 300, fontFamily: 'Vazirmatn', toolbar: { show: false } },
    series: [{ name: 'فروش', data: {{ sales_data_json|safe }} }],
    xaxis: {
        categories: {{ sales_labels_json|safe }},
        labels: {
            style: { fontFamily: 'Vazirmatn', fontSize: '11px' },
            formatter: function (val) { return toFaSimple(val); }
        }
    },
    yaxis: yaxisMillion,
    colors: ['#2E86AB'],
    stroke: { curve: 'smooth', width: 3 },
    fill: { type: 'gradient', gradient: { opacityFrom: 0.5, opacityTo: 0.05 } },
    dataLabels: { enabled: false },
    tooltip: {
        y: { formatter: function (val) { return toFaNum(val) + ' تومان'; } }
    }
}).render();


// ═══ مقایسه فروش ═══
new ApexCharts(document.querySelector("#compareChart"), {
    chart: { type: 'bar', height: 300, fontFamily: 'Vazirmatn', toolbar: { show: false } },
    series: [{ name: 'فروش', data: compareData.values }],
    xaxis: {
        categories: compareData.labels,
        labels: {
            style: { fontFamily: 'Vazirmatn', fontSize: '11px' },
            formatter: function (val) { return toFaSimple(val); }
        }
    },
    yaxis: yaxisMillion,
    colors: ['#8b5cf6'],
    plotOptions: {
        bar: { columnWidth: '50%', borderRadius: 6, distributed: true }
    },
    dataLabels: {
        enabled: true,
        offsetY: -25,
        formatter: function (val) {
            if (val === 0) return '۰';
            return toFaNum((val / 1000000).toFixed(1));
        },
        style: { fontFamily: 'Vazirmatn', fontSize: '13px', fontWeight: 'bold', colors: ['#333'] }
    },
    legend: { show: false },
    tooltip: {
        y: { formatter: function (val) { return toFaNum(val) + ' تومان'; } }
    }
}).render();


// ═══ منابع جذب مشتری ═══
new ApexCharts(document.querySelector("#sourceChart"), {
    chart: { type: 'donut', height: 280, fontFamily: 'Vazirmatn' },

    labels: {{ source_labels_json|safe }},

    dataLabels: {
        enabled: true,
        formatter: function (val, opts) {
            return toFaNum(opts.w.globals.series[opts.seriesIndex]);
        },
        style: { fontFamily: 'Vazirmatn' }
    },
    plotOptions: { pie: { donut: { size: '60%' } } }
}).render();


// ═══ قیف فروش ═══
new ApexCharts(document.querySelector("#funnelChart"), {

                </div>

                </svg>
            </button>
        </td>
    </tr>

<!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     JS — autocomplete + add row + live totals (۷.۱۰)
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<script>
(function () {
    'use strict';

    // ═══ دیکشنری کالاها ═══
    const productsData = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('products-data').textContent);

    // ═══ رفرنس‌ها ═══
    const container = document.getElementById('items-container');
    const emptyTpl = document.getElementById('empty-row-template');
    const totalFormsInput = document.querySelector('[name=items-TOTAL_FORMS]');
    const addRowBtn = document.getElementById('add-row-btn');
    const discountInput = document.querySelector('[name=discount]');
    const taxInput = document.querySelector('[name=tax_percent]');

    // ═══ ابزار: فرمت عدد ═══
    const fmt = (n) => Number(n || 0).toLocaleString('en-US');

    // ═══ محاسبه‌ی یک ردیف ═══
    function calcRow(row) {
        const qty = parseFloat(row.querySelector('.item-qty')?.value) || 0;
        const price = parseFloat(row.querySelector('.item-price')?.value) || 0;
        const total = qty * price;
        const cell = row.querySelector('.row-total');
        if (cell) cell.textContent = fmt(total);
        return total;
    }

    // ═══ محاسبه‌ی همه + خلاصه ═══
    function calcAll() {
        let subtotal = 0;
        container.querySelectorAll('.item-row').forEach((row) => {
            // اگه ردیف مخفی/حذف‌شده باشه، نادیده بگیر
            if (row.dataset.removed === '1') return;
            subtotal += calcRow(row);
        });

        const discount = parseFloat(discountInput?.value) || 0;
        const taxPct = parseFloat(taxInput?.value) || 0;
        const afterDiscount = Math.max(subtotal - discount, 0);
        const taxAmount = Math.round(afterDiscount * taxPct / 100);
        const total = afterDiscount + taxAmount;

        document.getElementById('sum-subtotal').textContent = fmt(subtotal);
        document.getElementById('sum-discount').textContent = fmt(discount);
        document.getElementById('sum-tax').textContent = fmt(taxAmount);
        document.getElementById('sum-total').textContent = fmt(total);
    }

    // ═══ پر کردن خودکار قیمت ═══
    function fillPrice(row, product) {
        const priceInput = row.querySelector('.item-price');
        if (!priceInput || !product) return;

        // فقط اگه کاربر قبلاً قیمت دستی وارد نکرده، پر کن
        const currentPrice = parseFloat(priceInput.value) || 0;
        if (currentPrice === 0) {
            priceInput.value = product.price;
        }
        calcAll();
    }

    // ═══ مخفی کردن select اصلی + init search input ═══
    function initRow(row) {
        const wrapper = row.querySelector('.product-autocomplete');
        if (!wrapper) return;

        const select = wrapper.querySelector('select');
        const searchInput = wrapper.querySelector('.product-search');
        if (!select || !searchInput) return;

        // اگه مقدار انتخاب‌شده داره، در input نمایش بده
        const selectedOpt = select.options[select.selectedIndex];
        if (selectedOpt && selectedOpt.value) {
            searchInput.value = selectedOpt.textContent.trim();
        }

        // پاک کردن مقدار input در ردیف‌های خالی (جلوگیری از placeholder عجیب)
        if (!select.value && !searchInput.value) {
            searchInput.value = '';
        }
    }

    // ═══ رندر لیست پیشنهادها ═══
    function renderSuggestions(row, query) {
        const wrapper = row.querySelector('.product-autocomplete');
        const box = wrapper.querySelector('.product-suggestions');
        const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();

        if (!q) {
            box.classList.add('hidden');
            box.innerHTML = '';
            return;
        }

        const matches = productsData.filter((p) => {
            return p.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) || p.code.toLowerCase().includes(q);
        }).slice(0, 10);

        if (matches.length === 0) {
            box.innerHTML = '<div class="px-3 py-2 text-xs text-gray-400">کالایی یافت نشد</div>';
            box.classList.remove('hidden');
            return;
        }

        box.innerHTML = matches.map((p) => `
            <div class="product-suggestion px-3 py-2 hover:bg-blue-50 cursor-pointer border-b border-gray-100 last:border-b-0"
                 data-id="${p.id}"
                 data-price="${p.price}">
                <div class="flex justify-between items-center gap-2">
                    <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
                        <div class="font-medium text-gray-800 text-sm truncate">${escapeHtml(p.name)}</div>
                        <div class="text-xs text-gray-400 font-mono" dir="ltr">${escapeHtml(p.code)}</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="text-xs text-blue-600 font-bold whitespace-nowrap" dir="ltr">${fmt(p.price)}</div>
                </div>
            </div>
        `).join('');

        box.classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    // ═══ escape HTML ═══
    function escapeHtml(str) {
        const div = document.createElement('div');
        div.textContent = str;
        return div.innerHTML;
    }

    // ═══ انتخاب پیشنهاد ═══
    function selectSuggestion(row, suggestionEl) {
        const wrapper = row.querySelector('.product-autocomplete');
        const select = wrapper.querySelector('select');
        const searchInput = wrapper.querySelector('.product-search');
        const box = wrapper.querySelector('.product-suggestions');

        const id = suggestionEl.dataset.id;
        const price = parseFloat(suggestionEl.dataset.price);
        const product = productsData.find((p) => String(p.id) === String(id));

        if (!product) return;

        select.value = id;
        searchInput.value = product.name;

        // Trigger change event برای سازگاری
        select.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));

        // پر کردن قیمت
        fillPrice(row, product);

        box.classList.add('hidden');
        box.innerHTML = '';
    }

    // ═══ اضافه کردن سطر جدید ═══
    function addRow() {
        if (!emptyTpl || !totalFormsInput) return;

        const newIndex = parseInt(totalFormsInput.value);
        const html = emptyTpl.innerHTML.replace(/__prefix__/g, newIndex);
        const tbody = container;
        const temp = document.createElement('tbody');
        temp.innerHTML = html.trim();
        const newRow = temp.firstElementChild;

        if (!newRow) return;

        tbody.appendChild(newRow);
        totalFormsInput.value = newIndex + 1;
        initRow(newRow);

        // فوکوس روی input جستجو
        const searchInput = newRow.querySelector('.product-search');
        if (searchInput) searchInput.focus();

        calcAll();
    }

    // ═══ حذف سطر ═══
    function removeRow(row) {
        // اگه سطر ذخیره‌شده (دارای pk) بود، DELETE رو تیک بزن و مخفی کن
        const deleteBox = row.querySelector('input[name$="-DELETE"]');
        if (deleteBox) {
            deleteBox.checked = true;
            row.dataset.removed = '1';
            row.style.display = 'none';
            calcAll();
            return;
        }

        // اگه سطر جدید بود، کاملاً حذف کن
        row.remove();
        calcAll();
    }

    // ═══ Event Delegation — کلیک روی پیشنهاد ═══
    container.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        // کلیک روی suggestion
        const suggestion = e.target.closest('.product-suggestion');
        if (suggestion) {
            const row = suggestion.closest('.item-row');
            if (row) selectSuggestion(row, suggestion);
            return;
        }

        // کلیک روی remove-row
        const removeBtn = e.target.closest('.remove-row');
        if (removeBtn) {
            const row = removeBtn.closest('.item-row');
            if (row) removeRow(row);
            return;
        }
    });

    // ═══ Event Delegation — input روی search ═══
    container.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
        // جستجوی کالا
        if (e.target.classList.contains('product-search')) {
            const row = e.target.closest('.item-row');
            if (row) renderSuggestions(row, e.target.value);
            return;
        }

        // تغییر تعداد یا قیمت → محاسبه
        if (e.target.classList.contains('item-qty') || e.target.classList.contains('item-price')) {
            calcAll();
        }
    });

    // ═══ مخفی کردن پیشنهادها وقتی کاربر فوکوس رو از دست می‌ده ═══
    container.addEventListener('focusout', (e) => {
        if (e.target.classList.contains('product-search')) {
            setTimeout(() => {
                const row = e.target.closest('.item-row');
                if (!row) return;
                const box = row.querySelector('.product-suggestions');
                if (box) {
                    box.classList.add('hidden');
                    box.innerHTML = '';
                }
            }, 200);
        }
    });

    // ═══ پاک کردن input → پاک کردن select ═══
    container.addEventListener('focusin', (e) => {
        if (e.target.classList.contains('product-search')) {
            // اگه input خالی شد، پیشنهادها رو نشون بده
            if (!e.target.value.trim()) {
                const row = e.target.closest('.item-row');
                if (row) {
                    const select = row.querySelector('.product-autocomplete select');
                    if (select) select.value = '';
                }
            }
        }
    });

    // ═══ discount/tax input → محاسبه ═══
    if (discountInput) discountInput.addEventListener('input', calcAll);
    if (taxInput) taxInput.addEventListener('input', calcAll);

    // ═══ دکمه‌ی افزودن سطر ═══
    if (addRowBtn) addRowBtn.addEventListener('click', addRow);

    // ═══ Init — همه‌ی ردیف‌های اولیه ═══
    container.querySelectorAll('.item-row').forEach(initRow);
    calcAll();

})();
</script>

{% endblock %}

<!-- فیلترهای پیشرفته (۷.۶) -->
<div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm mb-6">
    <form method="get" class="space-y-3">
        <!-- ردیف ۱: جستجو + dropdowns -->
        <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-3 items-center">
            <div class="flex-1 min-w-[200px]">
                <input type="text" name="q" value="{{ search }}"
                       placeholder="جستجو شماره فاکتور یا نام مشتری..."

<script>
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
        if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key === 'p') {
            e.preventDefault();
            window.print();
        }
        if (e.key === 'Escape') {
            window.history.back();
        }
    });
</script>
